title: FPGA Engineer - Electronic Warfare
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission Own the development of FPGA functions for our electronic warfare and signals intelligence capabilities, from initial architecture to validation on operational hardware. Work with systems and algorithm engineers to define processing requirements and assess implementation feasibility. Build RTL modules in VHDL or SystemVerilog to process digitized RF signals, extract relevant information, and generate waveforms. Adapt and validate DSP algorithms for FPGA implementation, balancing numerical accuracy, processing speed, and hardware resources. Integrate acquisition and processing chains, including digital down-conversion, filtering, channelization, FFT, detection, direction-finding, and classification. Establish verification methods and testbenches to check functional behavior and performance throughout development. Connect programmable logic to RF converters and embedded processors, defining data transfers, control interfaces, clocking, and synchronization. Resolve implementation constraints, achieve timing closure, and optimize resource utilization and power consumption. Bring up FPGA designs on target boards, investigate integration issues, and correlate measured behavior with simulation results. Contribute to laboratory and field testing alongside RF, software, and systems engineers. Maintain clear design records, interface specifications, and validation evidence. Improve reusable FPGA components and development practices as the product portfolio grows. Candidate Profile MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field. Strong experience developing and verifying RTL in VHDL or SystemVerilog, with a focus on digital signal processing. Practical experience implementing designs on SoC FPGAs, including synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware debugging. Strong understanding of sampled signals, frequency conversion, digital filtering, spectral analysis, and fixed-point numerical behavior. Ability to reason across FPGA, processor, and RF hardware boundaries when making design decisions. Experience modelling algorithms and comparing reference models with hardware results; familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or HLS is a plus. Familiarity with RF measurements and laboratory equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes, is a plus. Prior experience in electronic warfare is welcome but not required. Skills & Qualities Hands-on engineer who enjoys taking designs from simulation to working hardware. Methodical approach to debugging, with the ability to isolate problems across complex signal chains. Able to own a technical scope independently and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly. Rigorous approach to verification, documentation, and design traceability. Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and adapting to evolving product requirements. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company. title: FPGA Engineer - Radar

We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission Turn radar sensing requirements into FPGA designs that support reliable drone detection in operational conditions. Define how radar data is acquired, processed, and delivered to the rest of the system, working across RF, electronics, and software teams. Establish processing budgets and select implementation approaches based on detection performance, latency, numerical accuracy, and available FPGA resources. Develop reference models to study radar behavior in noise and clutter and guide hardware design decisions. Build reusable RTL functions for waveform generation and receive processing in FMCW and pulsed radar systems. Implement the processing stages needed to extract targets from radar returns, including matched filtering, pulse compression, range-Doppler processing, clutter rejection, and CFAR detection. Integrate ADC/DAC interfaces, coordinate transmit and receive timing, and ensure synchronization with the radar front end. Specify how detections and associated measurements are passed to tracking functions and embedded software. Verify designs against reference models through automated testbenches and hardware-in-the-loop testing. Investigate performance gaps on target hardware and use laboratory measurements and field results to improve the processing chain. Document design decisions, interfaces, and validation results to support integration and future product development. Candidate Profile At least three years of FPGA development experience, with practical exposure to radar or sonar processing. Ability to take a signal-processing function from an algorithmic description to verified RTL in VHDL or Verilog/SystemVerilog. Strong DSP foundations, including FFT, digital filtering, windowing, and the effects of quantization and fixed-point precision. Understanding of how radar systems estimate target range and velocity, distinguish returns from clutter, and set detection thresholds. Working knowledge of matched filtering, pulse compression, range-Doppler maps, and CFAR techniques. Familiarity with FMCW and pulsed radar, including the relationship between waveform choices, acquisition timing, and digital processing. Experience assessing radar performance through simulation, including signal-to-noise ratio and clutter effects. Experience developing testbenches, debugging FPGA hardware, and validating processing chains with hardware-in-the-loop methods. Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, or a related field. Skills & Qualities Hands-on engineer motivated by making radar processing work reliably on physical hardware. Able to connect system-level performance issues with their causes in algorithms, RTL, interfaces, or timing. Methodical approach to debugging, verification, and documenting technical decisions. Comfortable owning development tasks and coordinating integration work across disciplines. Clear communicator who makes trade-offs explicit and flags risks early. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company. High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies. title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting! Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads . You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki . About the role The role is focused on the business needs - you'll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses. Your daily work will include Developing reporting and metrics quality as a whole, from understanding the needs of the business to providing easily understandable and actionable data. Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github). Design and implement complex data pipelines with dependency control, orchestration, and auto-materialisation logic. Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation. Increase data literacy across the domain and expertise through hands-on training and documentation. Lead, mentor, and guide more junior team members. Our humble expectations 5+ years of experience working as an Analytics Engineer or BI Developer. Strong hands-on experience with data integrations, data pipelines, data models, metric development, and dashboards . Tech skills: Snowflake, SQL, Airflow, DBT, Looker, or other visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc. Advanced SQL skills and ability to write optimized queries for large data sets. Strong business acumen and product-oriented thinking with significant experience in the design and implementation of analytics and reporting data models. What we offer The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics. You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki . You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙 You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)  Brand, Content & E-Commerce · Vollzeit · Münster
description: Zwei Marken. Viele Ideen. Und du bringst sie in die Umsetzung. leevje und I AM EDITIONS stehen für Mode, Ästhetik und eine starke Community. Während leevje seit vielen Jahren für besondere Kinderkollektionen steht, entwickeln wir mit I AM EDITIONS unsere Womenswear-Marke mit einem klaren, modernen und hochwertigen Look konsequent weiter. Für unser Team in Münster suchen wir ein echtes Organisationstalent mit Gespür für Fashion, Content und digitales Marketing . Du behältst den Überblick, übernimmst Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen, Kollektionen und Strategien konkrete Kampagnen, Inhalte und Launches entstehen. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Du planst und pflegst unseren Marketing-, Content- und Launchkalender. Du koordinierst Kampagnen und sorgst dafür, dass Inhalte und Assets rechtzeitig fertig sind. Du planst und betreust unsere Instagram-Kanäle und setzt Postings und Stories um. Du produzierst bei Bedarf selbst einfachen Foto- und Video-Content und fühlst dich auch vor der Kamera wohl – spontan in einer Story zu sprechen oder selbst Teil unseres Contents zu sein, ist für dich kein Problem. Du organisierst Shootings und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Ressourcen und UGC-Creator. Du planst und erstellst unsere Newsletter in Klaviyo und entwickelst Kampagnen, Segmente und automatisierte Flows weiter. Du planst und setzt unsere WhatsApp-Kommunikation um. Du pflegst Produkte und Inhalte in Shopify , legst neue Produkte an und erstellst Produkt-, Launch- und Shoptexte. Du aktualisierst Collections, Landingpages und Shopinhalte rund um unsere Drops. Du sorgst dafür, dass Kampagnen nicht nur geplant, sondern auch sauber und pünktlich umgesetzt werden. Je nach Erfahrung und Interesse kannst du weitere Bereiche wie Paid-Social-Creatives und Performance Marketing mit übernehmen. Qualifikation Das solltest du mitbringen Du bist sehr gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und denkst selbstständig die nächsten Schritte mit. Du hast ein gutes ästhetisches Gespür für Mode, Bildsprache und Marken. Du bist kommunikativ, offen und präsent und hast keine Scheu davor, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen und unsere Marken authentisch nach außen zu vertreten. Du interessierst dich für Social Media, Content, E-Commerce und CRM. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im Marketing, E-Commerce, Fashion-, Beauty- oder Lifestyle-Umfeld mit. Erfahrung mit Shopify und Klaviyo ist ein Plus – wichtiger ist uns, dass du dich schnell und eigenständig in neue Tools einarbeitest. Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl und kannst Texte sicher formulieren. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gutes Englisch. Berufserfahrung ist für uns ein Plus – aber nicht entscheidend. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du organisiert bist, mitdenkst, Verantwortung übernimmst und ein echtes Gespür für unsere Marken mitbringst. Wer besonders gut zu uns passt Du bist jemand, der bei einem bevorstehenden Drop automatisch denkt: Was brauchen wir dafür? Wer produziert was? Wann müssen die Bilder fertig sein? Sind die Produkte online? Ist Instagram vorbereitet? Stehen Newsletter und WhatsApp? Und ist am Launch-Tag wirklich alles ready? Du magst schöne Dinge – aber genauso sehr magst du es, wenn ein Plan aufgeht. Genau diese Verbindung aus Organisation, Ästhetik, Kommunikation und Hands-on-Mentalität suchen wir. Rahmenbedingungen Vollzeit / 40 Stunden pro Woche Arbeitsort: Münster Präsenzstelle bei uns im Team vor Ort Start: idealerweise zwischen dem 01.12.2026 und 01.01.2027 Über uns leevje und I AM EDITIONS sind inhabergeführte Fashionbrands aus Münster. Wir arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, entwickeln unsere Marken konsequent weiter und möchten besonders I AM EDITIONS in den kommenden Jahren stark ausbauen. Wir suchen niemanden, der nur Aufgaben abarbeitet, sondern jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Struktur schafft, mitdenkt und gemeinsam mit uns unsere Marken weiterentwickelt. Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Design Engineer
description: Mercura ( YC W25 ) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months . With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US. About the role You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked. That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything. We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you. What you will be working on Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building. Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it. Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so. Set the quality floor. Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you. Compress the loop. Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR. What we're looking for Evidence of discovery. You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong. Evidence of analytics. You've made a product decision from data you instrumented yourself. You know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered. Taste. You notice when spacing is off, when a flow doesn't communicate, when an interaction feels sluggish — and you fix it without being asked. We'll look at what you've made. Real code shipped to real users. React and TypeScript to production. Not prototypes, not a bootcamp project. Some Python helps; we can teach it. AI as leverage, not as identity. We don't care which tools you use. We care that you've restructured how you work around them and can show us the difference it made. German and English. Our users are almost entirely German-speaking. You'll be in those conversations from week one. How we work In the office, Munich, five days a week. We build in the same room — decisions happen at desks, not in tickets. Relocation support if you're not here yet. High pace, steep learning curve. Most of the team is here well past six. That's not a policy or a number we track, it's what building something this size with sixteen people currently takes, and it's a phase, not a permanent state. If you're optimising for predictable hours right now, this is the wrong role, and that's a completely reasonable thing to be optimising for. This is not the role if you want specs handed to you, you separate "my design work" from "my engineering work," you need a design system before you can start, or your best work needs a slide to explain it. About the Founders We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean , the co-founders of Mercura. We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility. Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs. Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry. At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins. Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others. title: Graphene Process Development & Innovation Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are seeking an experienced Graphene Process Development & Innovation Engineer at Black Semiconductor to lead the development, integration, optimization, and manufacturing implementation of graphene transfer, lamination, patterning, and related wet processes for next-generation IGP™ devices. This role combines graphene process development, equipment integration, wafer handling/lamination, wet processing, and manufacturing engineering. You will work across the technology lifecycle, from R&D and process development through equipment qualification, fab startup, production ramp-up, and sustained manufacturing. You will work closely with Process Integration, Device, Equipment, Facilities, Metrology, Manufacturing, R&D, and external technology partners to develop reliable, scalable, and manufacturable graphene solutions. To join our team, you should be excited to Graphene Process Development Lead the development and optimization of graphene transfer, lamination, handling, patterning, and related wet processes for IGP™ applications. Develop scalable graphene process flows from R&D through qualification and manufacturing ramp-up. Develop and optimize wet processes, including cleaning, surface preparation, chemical treatment, resist processing, graphene patterning, and post-process cleaning. Establish process windows to achieve the required graphene quality, adhesion, uniformity, cleanliness, pattern fidelity, and device performance. Evaluate and qualify new materials, chemicals, tapes, carriers, processes, and technologies for graphene integration. Drive process innovation and solve complex graphene integration and manufacturing challenges. Equipment Development & Integration Lead the development and integration of graphene transfer, lamination, wafer mounting, tape application, wafer handling, and wet-process equipment. Define equipment requirements, specifications, process capabilities, and automation requirements. Support equipment selection, design/modification, installation, commissioning, FAT/SAT, qualification, and production release. Work with equipment suppliers and OEMs to develop and modify equipment for Black Semiconductor’s graphene processes. Optimize equipment configuration, recipes, wafer handling, vacuum, motion, tension control, and automation. title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
description: Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment. We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team . The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. What will your job look like Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints. Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components. Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform. Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup). Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target. Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack. Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware. All you need is: Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field. 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work. Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel. Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout. Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch). Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image. Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf. Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup. Nice to have: Background in Automotive Software .\ Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows). Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal. Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join us? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements. Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months. Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team. Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements. For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans. Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines. Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams. What is expected of you Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment. A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from. The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them. Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software. Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning. We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English. Additional experience we value: Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis). Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM). Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer). A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the job Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering. You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases. This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making. You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics. Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems. What you will do Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost. Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools. Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs. Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation. Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations. Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior. Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation. About you You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows. You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field. You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics. You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability. You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition. You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation. You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans. You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders. It would be great if you Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems. Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows. Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers. Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the role Join Mistral AI’s Defense team to build software for defense institutions and industry. We are looking for an experienced software engineer with strong engineering fundamentals and a background in data engineering or transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You will help shape the architecture, write production code and own substantial software components, from design through deployment and operation. This role offers the scope and autonomy of a senior technical individual contributor in a small team. It is particularly suited to engineers operating at Senior or Staff level in demanding product engineering environments who want broad ownership and to stay deeply involved in implementation. What you will do Design and build services for data ingestion, transformation, storage, querying and operational workflows. Develop shared data models, APIs and SDKs that help engineers build applications on a consistent foundation. Make authorization a core part of the architecture: define and enforce which users, applications and agents can access data or perform actions, with clear audit trails. Solve problems involving data consistency, schema evolution, concurrency, performance and failure recovery across services and data systems. Turn needs from our applied engineers and defense users into reusable software capabilities, making pragmatic choices about what to build and how to evolve them. Own delivery end to end, including implementation, testing, observability, debugging and maintainability in demanding deployment environments. Use AI coding tools and coding agents extensively to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring and debugging. Help the team improve these workflows while maintaining a high engineering standard. What we are looking for Strong practical familiarity with AI coding tools and agentic engineering workflows. You use coding agents regularly, can break complex work into well-scoped tasks, provide effective context, review generated code and validate the result through tests and debugging. You remain accountable for the architecture, correctness, security and maintainability of what you ship. A strong track record of building and operating production software, with substantial ownership of complex systems. Experience in data engineering or in building transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You understand the trade-offs behind data models, storage, query execution and service boundaries. Experience building products where access control, permissions and data governance are central to how the system works. Work on platforms such as Foundry, or systems with comparable requirements, is particularly relevant. Broad software engineering skills and the ability to move between architecture, implementation and production debugging. You are comfortable working across unfamiliar parts of a codebase. Strong proficiency in Python or another programming language, solid SQL skills and the ability to become productive quickly in a Python and TypeScript environment. High autonomy and sound judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a concrete plan, make technical decisions and deliver useful increments with limited supervision. A collaborative approach to technical leadership through code, design discussions, reviews and mentoring, and a clear motivation to build software for defense institutions and industry. Nice to have Experience building a data platform or developer product used by other engineering teams. Experience with fine-grained authorization, multi-tenant architectures, data lineage or auditable operational workflows. Experience with self-hosted software, restricted networks or other demanding deployment constraints. Familiarity with LLM applications and their integration with data and tools. title: R&D Engineer - Optical Systems & Single-Photon Source Lithography
description: Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 About this position: We are looking for a R&D Engineer - Optical Systems & Single-Photon Source Lithography to support the development of novel designs of Single Photon Sources (SPS) for Quandela’s SPS R&D department. This position combines advanced optical experiments, hands-on R&D, and manufacturing engineering. The SPSL Engineer will play a key role in the fabrication of new designs of SPSs, that will be further tested by colleagues on characterization testbenches. The role will have a strong focus on in-situ localization of quantum dots (QDs) at cryogenic temperatures and lithography over the localized QDs with laser writing techniques. The successful candidate will work closely with our SPS R&D team, SPS production team, fabrication engineers, equipment owners, and cleanroom operators to improve performance of the SPSs and successfully transfer R&D advances to our production mainline. This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of optics and semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology, and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. Key responsibilities Improving SPS performance Develop, optimize and stabilize QD positioning and laser lithography process on R&D “experimental” epitaxial wafer growths with high-performance potential. Contribute to the development of GUIs and automation software in the Python programming language. Contribute to the development of fully automated QD-positioning and lithography tools on complex, “experimental” epitaxial wafer growths. Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. R&D to Production Transfer Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes, and production volumes. Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transferring to production. Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training, and technical communication. Detect process drifts, investigate deviations, and define corrective and preventive actions. Equipment & Production Support Contribute to the development of novel fabrication setups, both on the hardware and software side. Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. Process Characterization & Data Analysis Develop appropriate data analysis tools to identify process sensitivities, and optimization opportunities. Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support experiments development and troubleshooting. Documentation & Communication Ensure frequent and clear reporting of experimental results, risks and improvement actions. Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. Requirements Required Qualifications & Experience : Master's degree or PhD in Optics, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. Hands-on experience in design, assembling, and alignment of optical systems. Hands-on experience in design, assembling, and operation of electronic devices Python programming language fluency. Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. Strong communication and documentation skills. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications : Experience in development of GUIs with the Python programming language. Good understanding of quantum physics in general and more specifically of quantum optics. Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators, or VCSEL-type technologies. We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new systems where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, developing Python projects, solving complex fabrication problems, and collaborating across R&D and production teams. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one A team eager to collaborate and grow with you Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between. Process Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') Hiring Manager Interview (45') Use Case / Practical Assessment : The use case will consist of a simple practical exercise focused on the alignment of an optical bench. The assessment will take place in the cleanroom, they are not considered PPE for this exercise. Meeting with the teams 2 reference check Offer (This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles) At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. title: Photonic Packaging Engineer
description: About Quandela Quandela is a global leader in photonic quantum computing, developing hardware and software technologies to build scalable and energy-efficient quantum systems. With more than 140 people, we develop our own stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic integrated circuits to quantum control systems, software and algorithms. Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers. Reaching this scale requires increasingly reliable, manufacturable and integrated photonic hardware, making our Integrated Photonics team a key part of this journey. About this position: You will join our Integrated Photonics team, working across Massy and Palaiseau at the interface between PIC design, characterization, packaging and system integration . We are looking for a hands-on Photonic Packaging Engineer to take ownership of our packaging activities, improve existing processes and help make our PIC integration more reliable and reproducible. Your first priority will be to contribute to ongoing packaging activities, develop and improve assembly processes, and troubleshoot integration challenges alongside our PIC design and characterization teams. As you grow into the role, you will also have the opportunity to develop new packaging approaches, coordinate technical projects and contribute to building more structured and scalable packaging capabilities. Why this role matters: Today, packaging activities involve several members of our team. Having a dedicated engineer will help us accelerate ongoing developments, improve the reproducibility of our processes and strengthen the connection between PIC design, characterization and system integration. As our PIC platforms evolve, your work will also contribute to developing new integration approaches and preparing our packaging processes for future scale-up. Requirements What will you do: Develop and improve photonic packaging processes: • Take ownership of ongoing packaging activities and improve existing processes. • Develop optical coupling, precision alignment and fiber-array attachment methods. • Work on component assembly, bonding and electrical interconnections. • Address mechanical and thermal integration challenges. • Test new approaches, troubleshoot issues and improve process reproducibility. Qualify and improve packaged devices: • Build and test prototypes to validate packaging approaches. • Define performance metrics, tolerances and acceptance criteria. • Characterize packaged PICs alongside the PIC Characterization team. • Troubleshoot optical, electrical and mechanical integration issues. • Establish repeatable procedures and technical documentation. Connect packaging with PIC design: • Work closely with PIC Designers to anticipate packaging constraints. • Translate assembly challenges into practical design-for-packaging guidelines. • Collaborate with characterization and system-integration teams to improve packaged device performance. Build the packaging capability: • Collaborate with external packaging partners and equipment suppliers. • Improve existing equipment, assembly methods and internal capabilities. • Explore new packaging technologies and integration approaches. • Support automation to improve accuracy, reproducibility and throughput. • Progressively lead technical projects and contribute to future scale-up. How you'll grow: 0–3 months → Get familiar with our PIC platforms, existing packaging processes and integration challenges. Contribute to ongoing activities and start taking ownership of selected technical tasks. 3–6 months → Take increasing responsibility for packaging processes, develop and test improvements, and contribute to making our assembly methods more reliable and reproducible. 6–12 months → Lead packaging development activities within your area of expertise, strengthen our qualification and documentation practices, and contribute to new packaging approaches and technical projects. Longer term → Depending on your experience and interests, grow into a broader technical role, leading packaging projects, strengthening external partnerships and helping shape our future packaging capabilities. -- What we're looking for: Must-have: • Master's or PhD in Photonics, Physics, Engineering, Microelectronics or related fields. • Hands-on experience in photonic, optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging. • Practical experience in optical alignment, component assembly or related processes. • Good understanding of packaging tolerances, process development and qualification. • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues and develop reliable packaging solutions. • Professional English. Important, but you can grow here • Fiber-array / FAU attachment and fiber-to-chip coupling • Wire bonding, flip-chip integration or other electrical interconnection techniques. • Design for packaging, assembly and manufacturability • Mechanical and thermal integration • Experience working with external packaging suppliers or technology partners • Automation of packaging or precision-assembly processes Bonus • Packaging of integrated photonic devices • Experience with active photonic or optoelectronic components. • Cryogenic packaging • High-density electrical interconnection • Semiconductor production, process-engineering or NPI experience • Experience developping packaging equipment • Previous experience coordinating technical projects or leading packaging development activities. > You do not need previous experience in quantum computing. > What matters most is your ability to work hands-on with packaging processes, understand integration challenges and help us develop reliable and reproducible solutions. Benefits Join a growing quantum hardware company and contribute directly to the development of next-generation photonic quantum processors. • Take ownership of key PIC packaging activities and processes. • Develop reliable and reproducible packaging solutions. • Grow your expertise and contribute to future packaging developments. • Collaborate with PIC design, characterization and integration teams. • Work across photonics, semiconductor packaging and quantum hardware. - • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility • Company savings plan • 100% health coverage (Alan) • Transport reimbursement or mobility bonus • Swile meal vouchers • Access to Gymlib If your background is slightly different from what is described above but you bring strong hands-on experience in photonic, optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging, we still encourage you to apply. title: Presales Customer Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Sydney</strong>, <strong>Australia</strong></p> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><

title: Senior Customer Engineer, Singapore
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Job Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Senior Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer </li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> <li>This role requires frequent travel to Indonesia and work directly with clients communicate in Bahasa Indonesia. Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia is preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election infor

title: Software Engineer II
