title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Software) (all genders)
description: Your mission As our Quality Assurance Engineer (Software) , you will help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of ProGlove’s connected solutions across embedded and IoT devices, mobile applications, front-end experiences and back-end services. You will take ownership of quality assurance within the team, combining thoughtful manual testing with effective automation. By challenging assumptions, investigating complex system behavior and continuously improving how we test, you will help us deliver dependable products to our customers. In this role, you will: Take ownership of QA processes within the team and champion quality throughout the product development lifecycle. Analyze end-to-end system architectures, user flows and integrations to identify risks and gaps in test coverage. Create clear and concise test plans based on product and technical requirements and document them in TestRail. Plan and execute functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing. Contribute to our automation frameworks by designing and implementing new automated tests and maintaining existing test suites. Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing where it adds value. Configure and maintain dedicated test environments and test data and support performance and load testing when required. Share findings transparently, raise risks early and collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to resolve issues. Continuously improve our testing approaches, tools and ways of working. Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matter, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and applies pragmatic judgment. You bring 4+ years of relevant quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on test automation experience. You have experience building or contributing to automation frameworks and maintaining automated test suites. You understand and can apply the full Software Testing Life Cycle, including functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing. You can analyze end-to-end architectures, user flows and integrations, identify quality risks and translate them into appropriate test coverage. You have hands-on experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Pytest, Cypress, Selenium, Appium or REST Assured. You are comfortable configuring and maintaining test environments and test data. You have experience executing performance or load tests. You take end-to-end ownership, communicate clearly and raise risks early. You enjoy investigating complex issues, challenging assumptions and balancing thoroughness with pragmatism. You collaborate openly with engineers and other stakeholders. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required: Python or JavaScript and Git UNIX or Linux environments Agile product development environments Test documentation tools, especially TestRail AWS or other cloud platforms Testing embedded systems, IoT devices, mobile applications or connected hardware ecosystems Why us? Diversity and inclusion: Diversity is core to us and one of the reasons for our success. Career development: We support active and individual career planning and progression at your own pace. Cutting-edge technology: Choose the devices that work best for you from our range of supported IT products. Location-specific benefits: Benefit from offerings tailored to your location, such as gym membership, pension funding and mobility support. ProHealth: Our global health program supports the physical and mental well-being of all team members. Employee referral rewards: Earn €2,000 before tax by referring someone who joins our team. Office events: In addition to our summer and winter parties, smaller office events are part of everyday life at ProGlove. What success looks like Quality risks are identified early, communicated clearly and addressed before they affect customers. Critical user flows and integrations have reliable, risk-based test coverage across the relevant platforms and system components. Automated test coverage grows in a maintainable way and supports faster, more confident releases. Test plans, results and quality documentation are clear, current and useful to the relevant stakeholders. QA is an active part of product development, with shared ownership of quality across the team. Testing processes, environments and tools become more effective and scalable over time. Meet your team You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with software, embedded and mobile engineers, as well as other relevant stakeholders across Product and Engineering. The team values hands-on collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of product quality. You will contribute your perspective early in the development process, help the team understand quality risks and work together with colleagues to turn requirements and user flows into practical, maintainable test coverage. title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description: Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem. ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure. Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity. You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners. Your day-to-day Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals. Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions. Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions. Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale. Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity. Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition. Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities. Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes. Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns. Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities. Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions. You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions. You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value. You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments. You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed. You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like. You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined. You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority. You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences. You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake. You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required: Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services. Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management. Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems. APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations. Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems. Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale. Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem. Why us? This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. Join us in building the future of frontline work. What success looks like ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities. Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects. Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments. Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability. Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs. Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity. Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes. Meet your team You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager - EXOtube
description: Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across 48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies. Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube . Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand. Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany . The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. Your mission Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers. Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally. Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures. Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products. Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence . Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations. Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field. 5+ years of engineering work experience. Experience in customer-facing work and sales work. Excellent written and spoken English. Excellent technical communication skills. Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks. Editing, grading, sound, subtitles, and a version that fits each channel. Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet. Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten. Equipment : Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes. Steueroptimierte Benefits : Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen. Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc. BusinessBike : Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen. title: Lakebase Sales Specialist, Associate Director (Germany)
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">SLSQ327R341</p> <p>Databricks is seeking multiple <strong>Lakebase Sales Specialists (Central) </strong>to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with <strong>Databricks Lakebase</strong>, our <strong>fully-managed Postgres</strong> offering for <strong>intelligent applications</strong>. role is based in Munich, Germany (flexible within Germany for the right candidate), and will cover customers in the Central region (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe).</p> <h2><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive new Lakebase revenue</strong> by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.</li> <li><strong>Lead with outcomes</strong> for key Lakebase personas — including <strong>platform teams and developers</strong>, <strong>data teams</strong>, and <strong>central IT</strong> — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications</strong>, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.</li> <li><strong>Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles</strong> from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs</strong> that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.</li> <li><strong>Compete and win</strong> against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.</li> <li><strong>Align to measurable business outcomes</strong> such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.</li> <li><strong>Partner cross-functionally</strong> with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.</li> <li><strong>Enable the field</strong> by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like in this role</strong></h2> <p>This role requires the ability to operate across <strong>two key motions</strong> simultaneously:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Establish top strategic focus accounts</strong> by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.</li> <li><strong>Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration</strong> within Databricks' most strategic accounts.</li> </ul> <p>Candidates should demonstrate how they can <strong>act as a force multiplier</strong> across multiple dimensions of the business.</p> <p>Success in this role requires strength in four areas:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Business ownership</strong> – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.</li> <li><strong>Strategic account engagement</strong> – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Field, account, & customer enablement: </strong>Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.</li> <li><strong>Market voice and thought leadership</strong> – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.</li> </ol> <p>The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.</p> <h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience</strong>, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.</li> <li>Proven success selling <strong>data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure</strong> to technical buyers and business leaders.</li> <li>Strong understanding of <strong>modern data and application architectures</strong>, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.</li> <li>Ability to sell to both <strong>technical stakeholders</strong> (developers, architects, data engineers) and <strong>business stakeholders</strong> (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading <strong>specialist or overlay motions</strong>, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.</li> <li>Executive presence with the ability to <strong>whiteboard architectures</strong>, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.</li> <li>Strong <strong>value selling</strong> skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.</li> <li>Excellent <strong>communication, storytelling, and negotiation</strong> skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience selling <strong>Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services</strong>, ideally within large or strategic accounts.</li> <li>Familiarity with <strong>data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems</strong> (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.</li> <li>Understanding of <strong>reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics</strong> use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.</li> <li>Exposure to <strong>AI-native and agent-driven applications</strong> that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.</li> <li>Prior experience in a <strong>high-growth, category-creating environment</strong>, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with <strong>partners and ISVs</strong> to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.</li> </ul> <p><em>This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist description: <p><em>This is a fixed-term contract initially until 15th January 2027, with the potential for extension.</em></p> <p><em>Please submit your application in English. </em></p> <p><em>Must be fluent, C1/C2 or native in the German language.</em></p> <p><em>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.</em></p> <p><strong>JOB PURPOSE</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Copywriter, you’ll join our global Copy Team of nearly 60 creatives across the world. You'll craft content for digital channels and brand campaigns, delivering on-brand messaging that drives clicks, engagement, and brand awareness.</p> <p>We're looking for inspiring team players who are eager to share their expertise. You should be just as comfortable producing efficient, high-quality day-to-day work as you are developing standout ideas for award-winning campaigns and new business pitches. </p> <p>This role requires a genuine passion for editing and giving critical feedback. You will be expected to uphold our clients' creative standards, while continuing to push new ideas and embody DEPT®’s entrepreneurial spirit.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop creative concepts and outstanding copy for digital campaigns for a leading international brand.</li> <li>Write content for a wide range of channels, including banner ads, newsletters, websites, social media campaigns, and localized adaptations across text, design, and video formats.</li> <li>Apply strong conceptual thinking and creative writing skills to craft engaging and effective messaging.</li> <li>Proofread all German-language content to ensure flawless spelling, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.</li> <li>Present your ideas convincingly to colleagues and clients, showcasing the strategic and creative thinking behind your work.</li> <li>Adapt global campaigns for the German market in a way that feels authentic and culturally relevant.</li> <li>Conduct competitive and trend research to inspire fresh creative directions.</li> <li>Lead and participate in creative brainstorms and other key meetings.</li> <li>Demonstrate leadership, professionalism, and collaboration in all interactions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevant experience as a copywriter, ideally within an agency or brand environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise in multi-channel digital copywriting and brand development is a major advantage.</li> <li>Proven experience in translation, transcreation, and proofreading.</li> <li>Ability to write compelling, sales-driven marketing copy in German is essential.</li> <li>Confidence in working closely with designers, strategists, account managers, and clients.</li> <li>Ability to manage large-scale marketing campaigns with multiple deliverables at a fast pace.</li> <li>Understanding of the importance of consistency across touchpoints in the user journey.</li> <li>Experience using AI tools to support campaign and copy creation is a must.</li> <li>Highly collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork.</li> <li>Native-level or C1 German and excellent English skills, both written and spoken.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible hybrid working policy (2 days at the office, depending on location);</li> <li>Company pension scheme.</li> <li>Lease bike options / JobRad and 25% subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.</li> <li>Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform.</li> <li>€30 per month - You can use the flexible package for digital food stamps and/or fitness providers/sport clubs/massage studios, internet costs, and/ or public transport.</li> <li>Future Bens - Exclusive access to sustainable, healthy products at attractive deals.</li> <li>Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.</li> <li>A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/en-gb/insight/dept-is-a-certified-b-corporation/">B Corp® since 2021</a> and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.</li> <li>Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.</li> <li>Global annual <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/dept-cares-day-2023/">DEPT® Cares Month</a> in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.</p> <p><strong>AI Disclosure</strong>: At DEPT®, we use AI-assisted technology (Metaview) to capture notes and summarize interview conversations, so our interviewers can stay fully focused. Using the AI is optional, just let us know if you’d prefer it not be used.</p> <p><em><br></em><strong>DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION </strong></p> <p>At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.</p> <p>We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.</p> <p>Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? title: Sales Engineer, Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Sales Engineer, Banking is a technically credible, commercially aware member of the EMEA SE team, responsible for the full technical sales cycle across banking opportunities in Western and Central Europe.</p> <p>This is not a generalist SE role. You will be expected to engage deeply with treasury operations leads, custody technologists, CISOs, and risk committees inside Tier 1 and Tier 2 banks. You will need to understand how institutional banking technology works — core banking platforms, custody and settlement infrastructure, ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging, and post-trade workflows — and be able to position Fireblocks clearly within that context. You will work closely with Banking-aligned Sales Directors across your region, taking primary responsibility for technical qualification, PoC delivery, RFP responses, and solution design from first engagement through to onboarding handoff.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Pre-Sales</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead technical qualification for banking opportunities, distinguishing genuine digital asset programmes from exploratory noise</li> <li>Deliver tailored product demonstrations to technical and executive audiences across custody, settlement, treasury, and compliance use cases</li> <li>Scope, design, and deliver Proofs of Concept in bank environments — including navigating infosec review, sandbox provisioning, and API integration testing</li> <li>Produce and own RFP, RFI, and DDQ responses for banking prospects, maintaining accuracy against Fireblocks' external security and compliance attestations</li> <li>Present Fireblocks' security architecture to CISOs, CROs, risk committees, and product and business line leads with appropriate institutional credibility</li> </ul> <p><strong>Solution Design & Client Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Translate institutional banking requirements — custody flows, settlement logic, treasury management, regulatory reporting — into Fireblocks solution architectures</li> <li>Engage directly with bank technology teams on API integration patterns, core banking middleware, and operational workflow design</li> <li>Co-develop technical account plans with Sales Directors, identifying the path from initial engagement to production deployment</li> <li>Contribute to deal strategy on competitive situations, particularly against technology-first custody competitors</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Contribution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the voice of the banking client in internal product and roadmap discussions</li> <li>Contribute reusable technical content — solution briefs, reference architectures, PoC templates — that scale across the Banking vertical</li> <li>Support onboarding handoff to Professional Services, ensuring continuity from sales into delivery</li> <li>Participate in the EMEA SE enablement programme, contributing to banking-specific sessions and peer knowledge transfer</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>3–8 years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role, selling into or supporting Tier 1 or Tier 2 banks, financial market infrastructure, or capital markets firms</li> <li>Direct experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles in regulated financial institutions</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of scoping and delivering PoCs or technical pilots in bank environments</li> <li>Experience authoring RFP/RFI responses and engaging with bank procurement, legal, and infosec processes</li> <li>Exposure to digital asset, tokenisation, or blockchain initiatives whether from a technology vendor, infrastructure provider, or within a bank's innovation function</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working understanding of institutional banking architecture: core banking platforms (Temenos, Finastra, Murex, Calypso or similar), custody infrastructure, or post-trade settlement systems</li> <li>Familiarity with financial messaging standards: ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, or equivalent settlement and payment protocols</li> <li>Comfort with API-led integration patterns; able to engage credibly in technical discussions with bank engineering and middleware teams</li> <li>Understanding of cryptographic key management concepts, hardware security modules, or MPC/TSS architecture (formal training provided)</li> <li>Awareness of MiCA, DORA, or equivalent EMEA regulatory requirements as they affect digital asset operations in banks</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Credible with senior institutional stakeholders CISO, CTO, Head of Digital Assets, treasury operations leads, and product and business line owners — not only with technical teams</li> <li>Structured, precise communicator: able to write clearly, present confidently, and adapt register for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Commercially aware: understands deal economics, qualification discipline, and what constitutes productive SE engagement</li> <li>Self-directed and organised, capable of running multiple active opportunities simultaneously without close supervision</li> <li>A European language an advantage  </li> </ul> <p><em>For employees hired to work from the EU, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to</em><em> Germany</em><em> and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is</em><strong><em> </em></strong><em>€80,000 – €110,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. </em><br><em>While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. </em></p> <h6><em><a href="https://www.fireblocks.com/candidate-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Please see our candidate privacy policy here</a>.</em></h6></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Operations, Payments EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.</p></div><h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>Fireblocks Liechtenstein Ltd. is a payment institution being established to provide Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS) to institutional clients across the European Economic Area, under authorisation from the Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority (FMA). </p> <p>The Director of Operations is a controlling-function role and a member of the Company’s executive management. The role holds primary day-to-day accountability for the sound operation of the licensed entity, acts as the principal local point of contact with the FMA, and provides the substance and operational governance that underpin the Company’s authorisation. </p> <p>The role has a defined and focused scope: the Company provides AIS and PIS services, with its technology platform operated by an intra-group technology provider. The Director of Operations is responsible for governing that arrangement and ensuring the entity operates soundly, rather than for building or running technology directly. The role may also support the Fireblocks group’s wider regulated activities where relevant.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Regulatory and Governance</strong></h4> <ul> executive management in discharging their governance responsibilities, including preparation and follow-through on Board matters.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Operational Oversight</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Hold day-to-day accountability for the operational delivery of the Company’s AIS and PIS services.</li> <li>Oversee the outsourcing arrangement with the technology provider, including monitoring of service levels, quarterly service reviews, and management of the outsourcing register and sub-outsourcing controls.</li> <li>Own the Company’s business continuity and incident management framework, acting as the escalation and decision point in the event of a material disruption.</li> <li>Oversee the segregated operational processes that support the Company’s regulatory perimeter, including customer onboarding, support routing, and data governance in coordination with the Risk & Compliance function.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Risk and Control</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Work closely with the Risk & Compliance function to ensure an effective control environment across AML/CFT, operational, ICT, and outsourcing risk.</li> <li>Ensure the Company meets its obligations under applicable Liechtenstein and EEA regulation, including PSD2/ZDG and, as applicable, DORA.</li> <li>Oversee the maintenance of the Company’s risk register and the periodic and permanent control framework.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Commercial and Financial Governance</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Oversee the commercial and financial governance of the entity, including the intra-group service arrangements, in coordination with group finance.</li> <li>Provide operational sign-off on customer onboarding to the entity, ensuring the dual-entity contracting process is completed and customers are correctly provisioned.</li> <li>Support the Fireblocks group’s wider regulated activities where relevant, bringing operational and regulatory experience to bear. </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven operational leadership experience within a regulated financial institution — a payment institution, e-money institution, bank, or crypto-asset service provider.</li> <li>Experience of the Liechtenstein or wider EEA regulatory environment, ideally including prior involvement in a licence application and ongoing regulator engagement.</li> <li>A payments background, with an understanding of open banking (AIS/PIS), payment operations, and the associated regulatory obligations.</li> <li>Familiarity with outsourcing governance and the operation of a licensed entity that relies on an intra-group or third-party technology provider.</li> <li>Exposure to the digital asset sector is an advantage.</li> </ul> <h4>Attributes</h4> <ul> <li>The standing and seniority to act credibly as a controlling function before the FMA.</li> <li>Sound judgement, personal accountability, and the ability to operate as the responsible individual for a licensed entity.</li> <li>Able to work effectively with a distributed group, including colleagues in other time zones.</li> <li>Fit and proper for a controlling-function role, satisfying the FMA’s suitability assessment.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Location and Presence</strong></h3> <p>The role does not require full-time residence in Liechtenstein. able to collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues.</li> <li>Interest in practical AI systems and AI-enabled development. title: Systems Engineer, Network Automation

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil.</p> <p>You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows.</p> <p><strong>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience</li> <li>3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation.</li> <li>Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang)</li> <li>Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions</li> <li>Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse  (or equivalent SQL language)</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization</li> <li>Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents)</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems</li> <li>Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €54,000 - €75,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified. What you'll do Core engine development Design and build the systems that power Hydris. Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day. Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously. Protocol and integration architecture Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris. Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden. Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems. Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained. Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris. Distributed systems Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments. Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links. Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained. Technical leadership Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product. Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion. Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs. You should apply if you Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience. Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user. Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on. Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale. Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems. Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. Working language is English. German is not required. You'd be a great fit with Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management. Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525. Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with the Procurement organization, Legal, and Finance to deeply understand their operational processes and translate business requirements into sophisticated system solutions.</li> <li>Own the design, configuration, and delivery of complex workflows (e.g., global Procure-to-Pay rules, dynamic intake routing, and automated contract approvals) modernized stack.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Security, Compliance, & Data Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner closely with Internal Audit, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain robust IT General strictly adhere to SOX compliance, vendor risk policies, and maintain audit readiness for all financial and contract records.</li> <li>Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical procurement systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Bachelor’s <li><strong>Integration & Development Skills:</strong> Strong understanding of system integration logic (REST/SOAP APIs) and data flows across intake, CLM, and ERP ecosystems. Experience with scripting and building complex conditional workflows.</li> <li><strong>AI & Innovation Acumen:</strong> Familiarity with deploying, testing, or administering AI and machine learning features within SaaS platforms, specifically tailored to contract lifecycle and spend management.</li> <li><strong>Audit & Compliance Acumen:</strong> Extensive experience working in a SOX-compliant environment. title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
description: Your tasks Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship. Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved. Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended. Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next. Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging. From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly. Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs. Your profile Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half. Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people. Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be. Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic. Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models. Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters. Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement. Why us? Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers. Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket. Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known. Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about. How to Apply Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production : what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed. Process : Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer. We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway. title: Software Engineer, CDN Configuration Group
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London</strong></p> <h2>About Engineering at Cloudflare</h2> <p>Cloudflare's Engineering team is responsible for the software platform that serves tens of millions of HTTP requests per second on average. We also build and run the tools that empower our colleagues to rapidly deliver products to market, as well as monitor and deploy software updates across the globe to over 200+ data centers. You'll experience the full breadth of technologies needed to run one of the world's largest networks serving the world's largest customers such as Shopify and VISA.</p> <h2>About The Team</h2> <p>The CDN Configuration team oversees the end-to-end configuration ecosystem across our edge platform. Our core mission is delivering a coherent, safe, highly performant, and resilient experience that empowers customers to modify their traffic routing with absolute confidence. We enable users to build and tailor their own virtual network by rapidly generating settings and deploying updates globally without friction. While core teams engineer individual edge components, our group architecturally unifies these capabilities, enabling customers to seamlessly orchestrate their entire pipeline.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>Collaborating with skilled software professionals, you will deliver robust mechanisms that grant users total governance and safety across their network settings. Your focus involves architecting services that let users seamlessly prototype, execute, evaluate, and discard tailored traffic rules, ensuring optimal alignment with their operational requirements. This scope extends far beyond a solitary codebase; you will directly interface with distributed edge platforms, partnering with cross-functional groups to streamline and fortify our global infrastructure.</p> <p>In this role, you will stand at the intersection of core application deployment and infrastructure operations, driving technical alignment alongside engineering peers across the organization.</p> <h2>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</h2> <ul> <li>Solid competencies in practical computer science, applying the right algorithms, data structures, concurrency control systems to software design, and building large, distributed systems</li> <li>Experience operating production systems safely — deployment, rollout, rollback, and observability</li> <li>Driving communication and consensus across teams</li> <li>A drive for continuous improvement when it comes to both operations and new product development</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>These are things which the role is likely to require; we're happy to help you learn on the job, but prior experience is beneficial</p> <ul> <li>Experience of languages: Rust, Go</li> <li>Knowledge of web servers and web protocols</li> <li>Distributed systems, and distributed configuration or state-distribution systems</li> <li>Experience with safe deployment: progressive rollout, versioning/snapshots, CI/CD</li> <li>Web security issues and industry standards</li> </ul> <p>Most importantly, we are looking for people who want to learn something new. We maintain the largest web server in the world, and we face unique challenges. You will be collaborating and designing innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people around the globe, everywhere they are, whatever their needs are.</p> <p>Join and help us build a better Internet!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
description: About the Team OpenAI’s People team aims to hire, engage, and retain world-class talent to safely build and deploy universally beneficial Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). The HR team, a vital subset of the People team, supports a diverse group of scientists, engineers, and business professionals, with expertise spanning employee relations, immigration, compensation and benefits, learning and development, project management, and more. About the Role We’re seeking an HR Business Partner to support our growing teams across EMEA, with a particular focus on France. This role will help build scalable, locally compliant people practices and support strong employee relations as we grow. You will partner closely with regional People leadership, Legal, Employee Relations, and other People COEs to strengthen our approach to employee relations and employee representation in France. This will include building practical governance, manager practices, and operating processes that are compliant and sustainable as we scale. Beyond France, this role will serve as a trusted HR partner to managers and teams across EMEA. You will combine strong operational execution with thoughtful business judgment to support performance, organizational health, employee relations, and disciplined people practices at scale. This role reports into the International HRBP Lead, who owns regional organizational design and workforce planning. You will operate as a key regional execution partner to them, translating strategic direction into consistent delivery, elevating manager capability, and proactively surfacing people risks and themes. If you're joining us in person, we offer relocation support and follow a hybrid schedule: three days a week in the office, with the option to work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. Our offices are designed for focus and connection, with spaces for both individual work and collaboration. Your Responsibilities Lead employee-representative work in France: Partner with Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, and local stakeholders to own and deliver CSE-related processes, including elections, consultations, employee communications, documentation, governance, and effective ongoing operating rhythms. Build sustainable employee relations processes: Help establish clear processes for engaging with employee representatives, preparing for required information and consultation processes, maintaining appropriate documentation, and coordinating inputs from relevant business and People stakeholders. Support managers operating in the French employee relations environment: Equip managers and leaders with practical guidance on working effectively within French employment and employee-representation frameworks, escalating complex matters to Legal or specialist teams as appropriate. Drive strong day-to-day HR execution: Partner with managers across EMEA to support performance management cycles, feedback conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations matters with consistency and care. Be the go-to partner for frontline managers: Provide practical, timely guidance on team health, coaching conversations, policy interpretation, performance management, and manager enablement. Support and operationalize People programs: Help implement and maintain performance, engagement, retention, and employee experience initiatives, ensuring processes are clear, scalable, and well executed across different EMEA jurisdictions. Triage and resolve employee relations issues: Identify issues early, assess risk, recommend appropriate actions, and partner with Employee Relations, Legal, and other COEs on complex or sensitive matters. Maintain operational rigor: Track employee relations themes, maintain complete and accurate documentation, coordinate recurring processes, and ensure actions and commitments are followed through. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with HRBPs, Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, Total Rewards, and other COEs to provide a consistent and high-quality employee experience across EMEA. We’re Seeking Strong HR foundation: Approximately 8+ years of HR experience, including meaningful experience partnering directly with managers in fast-paced, high-growth, or complex international environments as a Senior HR Generalist or HR Business Partner. French employee relations experience: Practical experience working with French employment practices and employee representative bodies. Direct experience establishing, supporting, or working closely with a CSE, works council, or comparable employee representative structure is highly valued. Experience with employee representative processes: Familiarity with employee elections, consultation processes, employee representative communications, and the governance and documentation associated with formal employee representation. Execution-oriented partnership: Comfortable owning detailed, time-sensitive workstreams and coordinating across multiple stakeholders while maintaining sound judgment and strong follow-through. Strong project management: Able to take complex, multi-stage employee-representative processes and translate them into clear milestones, owners, dependencies, communications, and operating processes. Manager coaching capability: Able to guide managers through performance conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations issues with clarity and confidence. Operational strength: Brings structure, organization, and discipline to people processes and can build repeatable practices as the organization scales. Good judgment under pressure: Balances empathy, employee experience, business needs, and appropriate risk management while handling sensitive matters with discretion. High integrity: Trusted, fair, principled, and comfortable operating in an environment where confidentiality and sound judgment are essential. Language capability: Professional fluency in French and English is strongly preferred given the role’s responsibility for supporting employee relations and representative processes in France. title: Head of Financial Controller

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution. 💼 Your Responsibilities General Accounting Operations Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented Multi-Entity Oversight Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands) Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters Controls, Risk & Governance Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness Systems & Scalability Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable Leadership & Cross-Functional Support Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.
