title: Senior Majors Account Executive, New York
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: New York, New York<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this expert-level role, you will be the driving force behind Cloudflare's most strategic customer engagements, leading the charge in securing and expanding critical platform sales within focused accounts. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled sales leadership, a profound grasp of enterprise architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare seamlessly integrates into modern cloud operating models.</p> <p>As a Majors Account Executive, you will demonstrate the highest level of sales proficiency, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a recognized subject matter expert, providing in-depth education to customers and partners alike on Cloudflare’s extensive product ecosystem and its place within the broader security landscape. This role demands the ability to apply executive sponsorship programs, actively engaging with CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs, and leading virtual teams that include VPs and SVPs to navigate and close complex, transformative opportunities. You will shape our customers' digital transformation journeys, identifying opportunities within broader market trends and positioning Cloudflare as their indispensable strategic partner.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Executive-Level Strategic Revenue Leadership: Own and execute the most critical territory and account plans, consistently exceeding multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas by architecting and closing large-scale platform sales within highly focused, strategic accounts.</li> <li>Precision Forecasting & Pipeline Mastery: Lead with unparalleled accuracy in forecasting and demonstrate complete mastery of proactive pipeline management. Provide visionary insights and strategic guidance that shapes the direction of the sales organization.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture & Business Model Expertise: Exhibit an expert-level understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), seamlessly mapping these to customer business models. Articulate precisely how Cloudflare fits into and optimizes a modern cloud operating model.</li> <li>C-Suite Engagement & Executive Sponsorship: Lead and orchestrate complex customer engagements across numerous business units simultaneously, connecting the dots to solidify platform sales. Actively apply and manage executive sponsorship programs, ensuring direct engagement and influence with CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Drive and lead highly complex virtual teams that include Product Managers, VPs, and SVPs to manage and close the most strategic customer opportunities. Proactively identify and resolve organizational roadblocks, leveraging company-wide learnings to ensure the most efficient delivery.</li> <li>Digital Transformation Visionary: Serve as Cloudflare's leading voice on digital transformation, engaging deeply with customers on their key drivers for change (e.g., new offering development, customer capabilities). Expertly spot and seize opportunities for Cloudflare within broader market trends that influence these critical decisions.</li> <li>Organizational Communication & Feedback: Connect themes from across departments and global locations to craft critical, crystal-clear messaging. Review performance and output across multiple organizations, providing feedback and solutions to enhance the entire organization’s performance. Deliver challenging news within a constructive learning context.</li> <li>Long-Term Strategic Impact: Consistently articulate how decisions will impact Cloudflare years into the future, willing to trade short-term gains for significant long-term organizational benefit. Build trust by openly sharing learnings and modeling Cloudflare's highest expectations and standards.</li> <li>Define Goals & Drive Efficiency: Play a key role in defining team goals and metrics each quarter, rigorously reviewing results. Deeply understand interdependencies within and across teams, proactively addressing roadblocks to achieve results with maximum efficiency.</li> <li>Company-Wide Innovation & Problem Solving: Consistently and proactively address internal and external needs, driving urgency across the department and company to offer solutions that optimize efficiency. Constructively and humbly challenge the status quo to drive positive change and innovation company-wide, leveraging new insights for continuous iteration.</li> <li>Inclusive Leadership & Future-Proofing: Serve as an exemplary leader, consistently bringing in diverse perspectives to not only address today's needs but also anticipate and solve future problems, contributing significantly to the greater good of Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of expert-level experience selling complex, multi-million dollar technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with an irrefutable track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.</li> <li>Unparalleled in-depth knowledge of Cloudflare's entire product suite and the broader security landscape, coupled with the ability to educate both customers and partners at an expert level.</li> <li>Mastery in understanding Customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and adept at mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to apply and manage executive sponsorship programs, with extensive experience engaging directly and influencing CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in leading and orchestrating virtual teams comprising VPs and SVPs to manage and close the most strategic customer opportunities.</li> <li>Recognized authority on digital transformation, with a deep understanding of market trends and the ability to strategically position Cloudflare as a critical partner in driving customer innovation.</li> <li>Exceptional strategic communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, capable of delivering impactful messaging to the highest levels of customer and internal leadership.</li> <li>A visionary leader who consistently makes decisions for the long-term benefit of Cloudflare, even if it means trading off short-term gains.</li> <li>Proven ability to define team goals and metrics, drive cross-departmental efficiency, and proactively address roadblocks for optimal results.</li> <li>A humble yet assertive leader who consistently challenges the status quo and drives positive, innovative change across the organization.</li> <li>Expert-level proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC, etc.).</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required, with an MBA or advanced technical degree highly preferred.</li> <li>Ability to travel extensively as required to engage with key customers, executive leadership, and internal teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $350,000- $380,000 (base/variable)</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"><

title: Senior Social Legal Counsel - CDD (H/F)
description: Pourquoi rejoindre l'aventure Swile ? Depuis son lancement en 2018, Swile a révolutionné le marché des avantages salariés. En digitalisant la gestion et l’utilisation des avantages, grâce à notre super app, nous avons amélioré l’expérience, afin de la rendre plus simple, plus moderne et plus intuitive. Swile, c’est aussi une ambition forte : devenir le leader de la worktech, en cherchant à adresser, à termes, via nos produits, toute la sphère de la gestion de la vie au travail. Nous misons sur l’innovation technologique, un design soigné et une approche RSE rigoureuse, pour contribuer à améliorer le quotidien des travailleurs et des décideurs, tout en dynamisant l'engagement. Avec plus de 1000 collaborateurs et une présence internationale, notamment au Brésil, Swile a déjà convaincu des millions d’utilisateurs et des milliers d’entreprises. Rejoignez-nous pour bâtir ensemble un monde du travail plus épanouissant. Elle soutient les équipes au quotidien avec une approche à la fois stratégique, pragmatique et business-oriented, afin de sécuriser le développement de l’activité tout en permettant d’aller vite. 💫 Tes futures missions En tant que Juriste Droit Social , tu joueras un rôle central dans la sécurisation et la fluidité de la gestion RH au quotidien. Ton rôle consistera à faire du droit social un levier de sécurité, de pragmatisme et d’efficacité opérationnelle pour l’ensemble de nos équipes. Rattaché.e à la Directrice des Relations Sociales, et en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles, tu seras le garde-fou juridique capable de passer à l'action très rapidement dès que le feu vert est donné. title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Willkommen bei CBTW! title: Staff Cloud Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><p>Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you’ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!</p> <h1>About the Reconciliation team</h1> <p>Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world's largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.</p> <p>As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role. </p> <h1>What we are looking for</h1> <p>We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform.<strong> </strong>You'll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.</p> <p>This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. </strong>Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform. </li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership and mentorship</strong> to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.</li> <li><strong>Establish infrastructure standards and patterns</strong> for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.</li> <li><strong>Stay hands-on</strong>: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.</li> <li><strong>Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions</strong> with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 4+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.</li> <li>Deep expertise with AWS & Kubernetes. Minimum 5+ years experience with each.</li> <li>Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.</li> <li>Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.</li> <li>Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.</li> <li>A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you're energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.</li> <li>You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led — we're looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. </em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do Your Best Work</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Control of Your Finances</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employee giving match</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mobile phone stipend</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Care of Yourself</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">R&R days so you can rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. </em></span></p> <hr> <div><em>Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.</em></div> <div> </div> <div><em>Please find our <a href="https://ripple.com/legal/eu-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice </a>and our <a href="https://ripple.com/legal/ca-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">California Applicant Privacy Notice</a> for reference.</em></div> <div><hr></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£70,000 - £105,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> |</p> <p>We’re looking for <em>several</em><strong> Senior Product Marketing Managers </strong>to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo's most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth</p> <p>At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign & channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core </strong>is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.</li> <li><strong>Borrowing</strong> is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.</li> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Product Marketing for a Product. </strong>You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.</li> <li><strong>Become the expert on your market. </strong>You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning customers understand. </strong>You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Strategy. </strong>You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>Shape successful launches. </strong>You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters. </strong>You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You enjoy owning entire products.</strong> You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. </li> <li><strong>You solve ambiguous problems with evidence.</strong> You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.</li> <li><strong>You know what makes products win.</strong> You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>You influence through collaboration.</strong> You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.</li> <li><strong>You're always improving and helping others improve.</strong> You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Projektmanager:in Social Media & Paid Ads (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind fravio, eine junge, schnell wachsende Social Media Agency mit flachen Hierarchien und großen Ambitionen aus Köln. Unser Team arbeitet mit Brands wie Wolt, Miles, XING und Vodafone sowie den relevantesten Creators Deutschlands zusammen. Unser Fokus: Innovative Social-Konzepte, skalierbare Influencer-Kampagnen und Street Generated Content (SGC). Wir suchen jemanden, der die Brücke zwischen organischem Content und Paid Performance schlägt und beides operativ auf Top-Niveau umsetzt. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Als Projektmanager:in Social Media & Paid Ads bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Content und Performance. Du steuerst Ad-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok eigenverantwortlich, bewertest organischen Content auf sein Paid-Potenzial und sorgst dafür, dass aus Creator-Content messbare Ergebnisse werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creators, Produktionen und unseren Kunden zusammen. Deine Aufgaben Ad-Management: Du planst, schaltest und optimierst Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, inklusive Dark Ads und Spark Ads, für verschiedene Märkte mit klarem B2C-Fokus. Content-Bewertung: Du bewertest organischen Content strategisch und identifizierst, welche Assets sich für die Übersetzung in Paid Ads eignen. Creator-Koordination: Du kommunizierst mit kleineren Creators, buchst größere Creators für Ad-Produktionen, prüfst Skripte und stimmst dich mit Produktionen ab. Performance-Verständnis: Du weißt, was ein Pixel ist, verstehst, wie Landingpages konvertieren, und leitest aus Kampagnendaten konkrete Optimierungen ab. Account-Strategie: Du entwickelst perspektivisch organische Channels für Kunden und denkst Accountaufbau, Content-Strategie und Paid immer zusammen. Reporting: Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und übersetzt Zahlen in Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Erfahrung: Mindestens 2-3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Social Media Advertising oder Performance Marketing, idealerweise auf Agenturseite. Plattform-Expertise: Du kennst die Ad-Manager von Meta und TikTok in- und auswendig und weißt, wie Dark Ads und Spark Ads funktionieren. Content-Gespür: Du bist nicht nur Performance-Nerd, sondern verstehst auch, was organisch auf Social Media funktioniert, und kannst Content qualitativ bewerten. Regionaler Fokus: Du kommst aus dem Raum Köln/Umgebung, da dir die regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team im Office (Hybrid-Modell) wichtig ist. Analytik & Struktur: KPIs wie CPM, CTR, ROAS und Conversion-Rates sind dein Werkzeugkasten, du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kampagnen parallel im Blick. Sprache: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und flüssiges Englisch, da du auch mit internationalen Stakeholdern arbeitest. Benefits Was dich bei uns erwartet Echte Verantwortung: Du steuerst Ad-Budgets für einen der spannendsten Accounts Deutschlands eigenverantwortlich. Growth: Raum für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung in Richtung Senior oder Unit-Verantwortung. Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten & faires Hybrid-Modell (Home Office & Office-Tage). Vibe: Ein junges, ehrgeiziges Team, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Equipment & Perks: MacBook, modernes Office im Herzen von Köln, Jobticket und regelmäßige Teamevents. title: Auditor (all genders) at AI Audit-Tech Startup
description: You won't audit, you'll build what auditors use. We're looking for an experienced auditor who wants to switch sides: instead of working through audits, you'll shape the product that solves the real problems of the audit industry - with a real say in what we build next. Join an ambitious, international team and actively shape the future of dnl as well as the profession. About dnl dnl is a fast-growing AI startup building AI-first solutions for auditing . Our software automates disclosure checklists and other document-heavy audit work for audit firms and corporate clients, so professionals can spend their time on judgment instead of manual checking. Our mission: transform auditing through AI and help auditors work smarter than ever before. The role You bring many years of audit experience and use it to expand our platform conceptually. You co-decide which audit problems we solve next, design how our platform addresses them, and grow the value dnl contributes to every engagement. This role is for auditors, not career product managers: audit experience is required, product management experience is not. You know first-hand where audits lose time, where risks are missed and which workarounds teams rely on. You don't need to code. You need to think in structured processes and want to build the tools you always wished you had. You work closely with our engineering and AI team, our customers and the management team. Tasks Identify the biggest pain points across the audit process - from planning to reporting – and turn them into new product areas beyond the current setup Develop concepts for how our platform expands its coverage and grows its contribution to each audit engagement Co-decide our product roadmap with the management team and engineering: validate problems with audit firms, prioritise what we build next and specify the audit logic behind it - including what "correct" looks like Translate accounting and auditing standards (IFRS, HGB, ISA, IDW PS) into clear, software-executable logic , decision trees and workflows Design review and control mechanisms that keep the auditor in charge - transparency, traceability and professional skepticism instead of blind reliance on AI Make sure our results fit cleanly into audit working papers and firm methodologies Work hands-on with engineering and AI to test outputs, evaluate quality and ship improvements fast Be the voice of the auditor in the company and represent dnl with customers, at industry events and in regulatory discussions Requirements Must haves 6+ years in financial statement audit , ideally at a Big 4 or leading mid-market firm, up to (senior) audit manager level A solid understanding of engagement responsibility and liability risk - you know what it takes to sign off Strong command of IFRS and/or HGB as well as ISA and IDW PS , and the ability to turn standards into reproducible processes Structured, analytical thinking : you can sketch a decision tree and define the right outcome for edge cases The ability to explain complex topics simply to engineers, customers and decision-makers Hands-on experience with AI tools Motivation to reshape the profession , not just to take the next career step Native or near-native English - German is a plus You are Europe-based Nice to have Experience in product management , audit methodology or audit tooling /digitisation projects WP/CPA/ACA qualification or working towards one Benefits Creative freedom: You will be given ownership from day one in a team with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths. You will have the opportunity to actively shape the development and scaling of the company. First-class team: International and motivated team. Despite many different locations, regular (online) team events take place to celebrate our joint successes. Development opportunities : You have the opportunity to start your career in a fast-growing company as well as in Enterprise SaaS Sales, quickly climbing the first steps on the career ladder. Remote Work: We encourage flexibility by allowing you to work 100 % from home from anywhere within Europe. Attractive conditions: 30 days' vacation, attractive salary package, a monthly voucher and regular online and offline team events. Apply now and help shape the future of our company ! We look forward to receiving your application. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive DACH
description: Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and creating new opportunities and closing complex deals ? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you! Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that's transforming how some of the world's largest industrial companies operate? That's a different story. Peripass is a tech company at heart . We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and ArcelorMittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks loading and unloading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments. Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive Germany within the Sales Team, you will have a front-row seat to the growth of an international SaaS scale-up and play a key role in expanding our presence in the German market. Own the full sales cycle: You will be responsible for selling our SaaS solution and independently managing qualified sales opportunities from initial engagement through signed contract. This includes identifying and qualifying prospects, conducting discovery conversations, developing business cases, managing stakeholders, negotiating and closing deals. Build our presence in Germany: Identify target accounts and create new business opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting and personalised outreach across relevant industries. Work closely with our BDR team to open conversations with new prospects and build awareness of Peripass in the German market. Pipeline momentum and sales velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals. Existing customer growth: Identify opportunities for cross-selling and selling to additional sites within existing customer accounts, in close collaboration with Customer Success and other relevant teams. Deal negotiation and closing: Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect's needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalising contracts. Travel across Germany The role involves travelling approximately two to three days per week within Germany to meet prospects and customers. Work from our new German office : We are soon opening a new office in Hamburg. Visit our Ghent HQ approximately every six weeks to connect with your colleagues. To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first two weeks. You will report directly to Guillaume, our GTM Lead, who is looking forward to coaching you extensively as you build the German market and grow your career at Peripass. What we offer Front-row seat to scale-up growth: Be part of the next growth phase of Peripass in the German and have a direct impact on building our market presence. Opportunity in a growing market: Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionising yard management in logistics, with the opportunity to make an impact in Germany. Uncapped earning potentia l: A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn. Ownership and freedom: Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best. Backed by a strong team: From BDR and marketing to pre-sales and Customer Success, you'll have a strong team behind you, helping you create, close and grow opportunities. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h3><strong><span data-contrast="auto">The role</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></h3> <p>Nebius Token Factory is building fast, reliable, and cost-efficient inference services for frontier models. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on our Applied AI team, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking, with a focus on improving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while maintaining model quality and reliability.<br><br>This is a hands-on role in which you will work on complex optimization projects, diagnose difficult serving problems, and deliver measurable improvements in production. Working closely with kernel and platform engineers, you will evaluate serving configurations, resolve performance and quality regressions, and optimize inference for real-world workloads, supported by title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. </li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Engagement Manager (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Feasibility & Economics:</strong> Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Professional Backend Developer (w/m/d)
description: Wer Du bist Du hast 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Java-Stack und beherrschst Spring Boot souverän. Du entwickelst komplexe Features eigenständig von der Konzeption bis zum Release, denkst analytisch und trägst aktiv zu Architekturentscheidungen bei. Du nutzt KI-Assistenz (z.B. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) als etabliertes Produktivitätswerkzeug – nicht nur zum Code-Generieren, sondern auch für komplexe Refactorings, Architektur-Diskussionen und Debugging – übernimmst aber die volle Verantwortung für Qualität, Security und Nachvollziehbarkeit der Lösungen. Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe mit Stakeholdern und unterstützt gern weniger erfahrene Entwickler beim Wachsen. Wer wir sind Plunet GmbH mit Standorten in Berlin, Würzburg und New York entwickelt und vertreibt die Business- und Workflow-Management-Software „Plunet BusinessManager“ – eine der weltweit führenden Managementlösungen für die Übersetzungs- und Lokalisierungsbranche. Unsere Kunden sind führende Übersetzungsagenturen, Regierungsorganisationen und NGOs sowie große internationale Industrie- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Aufgaben Entwicklung & Architektur: Du entwirfst und implementierst komplexe, skalierbare Backend-Lösungen mit Spring Boot, inkl. Konfiguration von Security-Mechanismen und Integration von Drittbibliotheken. Du hilfst mit, technische Lösungen in unserer Software-Architektur zu gestalten. Qualitätssicherung: Du führst Code Reviews durch und stellst umfassende Testabdeckung mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest sicher – inkl. komplexer Integrationstests Legacy & Modernisierung: Du refactorst bestehenden Code und modernisierst Kernkomponenten (Main Classes), ohne dabei die Systemstabilität zu gefährden. Datenbanken: Du optimierst Datenbankabfragen und -designs (MySQL/MSSQL) und setzt Hibernate als ORM-Werkzeug für komplexe Mapping-Szenarien fortgeschritten ein. Wissenstransfer: Du bist aktives Mitglied in unseren Communities of Practice (CoPs), leitest diese bei Bedarf und mentorst Junior-Entwickler bei Onboarding und fachlicher Entwicklung. Integration: Du integrierst den Plunet BusinessManager mit externen Systemen und arbeitest eng mit Product Specialists zusammen. KI-Integration: Du nutzt KI-Tools effektiv für Entwicklungstasks, validierst generierten Code kritisch hinsichtlich Clean Code, Security und Performance und hilfst mit, Best Practices für den KI-Einsatz im Team zu etablieren. Qualifikation Erfahrung: 3-5 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit Schwerpunkt Backend/Java. Java Advanced: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von Design Patterns, Multithreading, Concurrency und aktuellen Java-Versionen. Spring Boot: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer, skalierbarer Anwendungen; sicherer Umgang mit Security-Konfiguration und externer API-Integration. Softwaretests: Advanced-Level in Unit- und Integrationstests mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest; Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung. Datenbanken: Fortgeschrittene SQL-Kenntnisse (MySQL, MSSQL), Query-Optimierung und sicherer Umgang mit Hibernate. Tooling: Sicherer Umgang mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines und modernen IDEs (IntelliJ, VSCode). KI-Assistenz Professional: Erfahrener Umgang mit KI-Coding-Assistenz für komplexe Entwicklungsszenarien; Fähigkeit zum effektiven Prompt Engineering; kritische Bewertung von KI-Vorschlägen hinsichtlich Architektur-Patterns, Security-Risiken und Datenschutz; Bewusstsein für Limitationen und Halluzinationen. Clean Code: Du lebst Clean Code-Prinzipien aktiv und hilfst anderen dabei, besser zu werden. Soft Skills: Starke analytische Fähigkeit zur Analyse komplexer Anforderungen und Entwurf effizienter Lösungen; hervorragende Selbstorganisation (Priorisierung, Zeitmanagement); exzellente Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten und Stakeholdern; Bereitschaft, Junior-Entwickler zu mentoren und Wissen weiterzugeben. Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2+), Deutsch ist ein Plus. Nice-to-haves (Zusätzliche Aktivitäten & Skills) Security: Erfahrung mit der Analyse und Behebung von Sicherheitslücken in Dependencies (OWASP Dependency-Check, Sicherheitsmanagement). DevOps/Tooling: Kenntnisse in Liquibase, SonarQube, GitLab Administration oder Docker. Performance: Erfahrung mit Performance-Analyse (Thread-Dumps, Heap-Dumps) und Last-tests. Fullstack-Perspektive: Grundkenntnisse in Angular, TypeScript oder .NET. Methodik: Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) als aktiver Teamplayer. Schulung: Du erstellst Präsentationen und Schulungen für andere Entwickler, um spezifisches Wissen zu verbreiten. Benefits Warum Plunet? Bei uns stehen die Menschen im Mittelpunkt Unabhängig & menschenorientiert: Plunet ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen ohne Investoren – deshalb können wir uns wirklich um jede und jeden Einzelnen kümmern. Wir fördern transparente Kommunikation und respektvolle Zusammenarbeit und geben allen eine Stimme. Work-Life-Balance: Genieße ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Dein Wohlbefinden an erster Stelle steht. Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, fairen Überstundenregelungen und der Möglichkeit, 4 Wochen im Jahr remote zu arbeiten. Nachhaltig unterwegs: Fahre ein Dienstrad (auch E-Bikes!) und nutze die steuerlichen Vorteile. Außerdem bezuschussen wir das Deutschlandticket. Gemeinsame Momente & gutes Essen: Wir kochen regelmäßig gemeinsam zu Mittag und frühstücken zusammen. Genieße Deine Mahlzeiten mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in unseren schön eingerichteten Büros in Berlin, Würzburg und New York. Unsere gut ausgestatteten Küchen laden zum gemeinsamen Kochen und Essen ein, und wir bieten einen Essenszuschuss (Profit von Hrmony). Und: WIR LIEBEN unsere frischen Obstkörbe :-D Eigenverantwortung & Agilität: Dich erwartet ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsfreiheit. Wir arbeiten agil und transparent und wollen unsere Ziele nachhaltig erreichen. Deshalb setzen wir auf flache Hierarchien und wenig Bürokratie. Plunet-Teamgeist: Wir leben den Plunet-Teamgeist: einen offenen, respektvollen Umgang miteinander über alle Rollen hinweg. Entwicklung & Wirkung: Werde Teil eines wunderbaren Teams, in dem wir aufeinander achten und gemeinsam die Marktführerschaft in der Übersetzungstechnologie vorantreiben. Arbeite mit modernen Technologien und bringe Dich in spannende, globale Projekte ein. Langfristige Stabilität: Werde Teil eines Unternehmens mit nachweislicher Erfolgsgeschichte: 22 % unserer Mitarbeitenden sind seit über 10 Jahren bei uns und 27 % seit 5–9 Jahren. Ein Beleg dafür, wie wichtig uns langfristige Bindung und Entwicklung sind. Ein Arbeitsplatz, den man weiterempfiehlt: Wir sind stolz auf unser unterstützendes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld: Das zeigen unsere 100 % Weiterempfehlungsrate auf Kununu und unsere Zertifizierung als familienfreundliches Unternehmen für 2026. Warum Du Dich bewerben solltest Die Entwicklungen im KI-Bereich sind rasant. Bei Plunet ermutigen wir unsere Mitarbeitenden, KI-Tools zu erkunden, sich damit weiterzubilden und sie in ihre Arbeitsabläufe zu integrieren. Für eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Anpassung. Auch wenn wir KI zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse einsetzen, spiegelt unser Recruiting-Prozess unsere Werte wider. Wir legen Wert auf Transparenz und Respekt und konzentrieren uns auf Fähigkeiten, Motivation und Potenzial. Alle Einstellungsentscheidungen bei Plunet werden von Menschen getroffen: Von der Sichtung jedes einzelnen Lebenslaufs bis zur finalen Entscheidung. In Live-Interviews setzen wir keine KI-Tools ein. In den Gesprächen geht es darum, sich gegenseitig kennenzulernen und zu verstehen, wie Bewerberinnen und Bewerber denken, zusammenarbeiten und an unterschiedliche Situationen herangehen. Wir stellen sicher, dass alle Entscheidungen über eine Einstellung von Menschen und nicht von Maschinen getroffen werden. Diversity & Inclusion Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit, Fairness und gegenseitigen Respekt ein und ermutigen Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, sich zu bewerben. Anonymer Bewerbungsprozess Du kannst dich gerne ohne Foto und ohne persönliche Angaben bewerben. Geschlecht, Alter, Name, Familienstand oder Herkunft sind für uns nicht entscheidend. Überzeuge uns mit deinen Qualifikationen, deinen Fähigkeiten und deiner Motivation, Teil von Plunet zu werden. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: Backend Engineer (Golang)

Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Why can this position be exciting for you? We are AMBOSS, and we’re looking for a Backend Engineer in the Shop team. Engineers at AMBOSS are at the forefront of shaping user experience for doctors and students, helping them make critical decisions, ultimately impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. We are looking for someone with a passion for technology who wants to keep growing their engineering craft while helping the team raise its bar. We work AI-first: agentic tools like Claude Code are part of our daily engineering workflow, and we are looking for someone excited to help shape how software gets built in this new era. Join our agile team on a mission to build and run the gateway that lets medical students and clinicians around the world access the AMBOSS platform If you’d like to learn more about our unique culture, check out this video. You will: Actively contributing to engineering projects within our Shop domain, from conception to completion. Apply best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability, and help us improve them. Use AI and agentic tools (like Claude Code) across the development lifecycle, from exploration and implementation to testing and code review. Help implement the team's technical vision, and take part in the strategy conversations behind it. Understanding why a given technology choice matters, not just what it is. Participate in incident resolution, get to root causes and build the preventative measures that stop a repeat. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine project requirements and specifications. Address Ad-Hoc requests from customer support channels. Share your knowledge within the AMBOSS community, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and growth. You bring: 3+ years of solid hands-on experience with Golang , plus MySQL or NoSQL. Solid experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code (or similar), and exposure to agentic engineering workflows. Experience across the web development lifecycle, including coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance; exposure to requirements analysis and system design is a plus. Experience building and integrating APIs (GraphQL and/or RESTful) and working with relational database design. Familiarity with SOLID principles, clean code, and common design patterns, and interest in applying them in day-to-day work. Proficient in using Git for version control, including branching, merging, and code review processes. Good to have experience with payment processing solutions like Stripe, Chargebee etc. Good problem-solving and analytical skills, and the ambition to take on increasingly complex technical challenges. Good verbal and written communication skills in English, able to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders. Good collaborative instinct to build real working relationships, help resolve team-level friction through clear communication, and step in when a teammate needs support. Curiosity, being interested in optimizing processes, learning domain’s ins and outs. Taking initiatives, having analytical mindset, being proactive and solution-oriented. A sense of ownership and the drive to see topics through. Benefits: AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. title: ICT Outsourcing Manager (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As our ICT Outsourcing Manager , you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to improve our third-party management process adding automation and AI supported assessments across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes. In this role you will: Act as the first line competence centre for ICT outsourcing and third-party governance topics, working across Technology, Compliance, Operations, business owners, and external partners to ensure risks and responsibilities are transparent and well managed. Own the operational execution of our ICT third-party and outsourcing governance framework across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing arrangements, so that key relationships are assessed, documented, and monitored in line with regulatory expectations. Drive risk assessments, due diligence processes, and recurring reviews for new and existing third parties, coordinating relevant stakeholders and turning findings into clear actions, decisions, and follow-ups. Maintain and improve the outsourcing register, governance documentation, and supporting evidence base, creating the level of clarity and traceability needed for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and partners. Prepare, structure, and run governance and review routines, including reporting, meeting preparation, escalation tracking, and action follow-up, to make third-party oversight more consistent, measurable, and decision-useful. Identify and advance process improvements, standardisation opportunities, and selective AI-supported automation in recurring third-party management workflows, helping the function become more scalable and effective over time. You’ll be successful in this role if you: Bring hands-on experience in ICT outsourcing, third-party management, vendor risk, IT governance, compliance-related operations, or a similar function in a regulated environment. Have a solid understanding of how external providers and outsourcing relationships are governed, documented, and monitored from a risk and compliance perspective. Are comfortable working with risk assessments, service levels, control evidence, recurring reporting, and cross-functional governance routines. Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, security-related topics, incidents, and operational dependencies without needing to be a security engineer. Work in a highly structured and reliable way, with strong follow-up discipline, good judgment, and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned. Communicate confidently in German and English, and enjoy making complex governance topics clear, practical, and actionable. How we take care of you: 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more / leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget. 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. title: AI Harness Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Harness Engineer based in Switzerland. As an AI Harness Engineer, you will build the systems and integrations that connect people with powerful local AI capabilities. You’ll work at the intersection of AI tooling, agent infrastructure, and peer-to-peer technology, helping create scalable experiences for the next generation of AI assistants. Your work will include developing reusable tools and modules, supporting diverse AI model types and sizes, and building reliable systems for non-deterministic environments. You’ll contribute to the evolution of P2P technology designed to enable local AI at scale. The role combines deep software engineering with experimentation and rapid technical exploration. Accountabilities Build and deliver new features and bug fixes with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and user satisfaction. Design and develop reusable tools, modules, and integrations that enable new AI capabilities across different model types and sizes. Build and maintain AI agent harnesses, including tool calling, agent loops, context management, and structured outputs. Maintain a high-quality codebase through consistent coding standards, code reviews, modular architecture, and automated testing. Design systems that can reliably handle failures such as network partitions, model errors, timeouts, and retries. Develop and maintain reusable npm modules and shared software components. Experiment with new technologies and approaches to continuously expand AI and P2P capabilities. Collaborate effectively with a globally distributed engineering team while communicating technical ideas clearly. Requirements 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software. Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, including experience modeling complex state across synchronization protocols, agent loops, or similar systems. Strong ability to write modular, maintainable, and reusable code. Hands-on experience building AI agent harnesses, including tool calling, context management, agent loops, and structured outputs. Experience developing evaluation systems and test infrastructure for non-deterministic AI or other complex systems. Experience creating and managing reusable npm modules. Strong testing and debugging skills, with a focus on reliability and production quality. Strong understanding of and practical experience developing and using AI tools. Deep interest or professional experience with peer-to-peer technologies, networking, or distributed systems. Experience designing resilient systems that account for network failures, model errors, timeouts, retries, and other failure scenarios. Contributions to open-source projects related to P2P, networking, AI tooling, or adjacent technologies are valued. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment. A highly experimental, hands-on mindset with a willingness to continuously test ideas, explore emerging technologies, and solve challenging technical problems. Benefits Fully remote work environment.
