title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>Official Title - Center of Excellence Engineer</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>Available Locations: Bengaluru, India</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2"><strong>About the Role:-</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2">As a Center of Excellence Engineer (Customer Solutions Engineer), you will provide technical guidance to Cloudflare customers. You are a Cloudflare product expert and will leverage your knowledge to ensure our customers understand and utilize the Cloudflare platform to its fullest extent. This is a customer-facing technical role focused on post-sale onboarding, technical advisory, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical events. You will be collaborating with CEs, AEs, Support and other internal teams to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.</p> <p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="4">Customer Onboarding and Deployment Readiness: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e.g., DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures.</li> <li data-path-to-node="5">Cloudflare Configuration Guidance: Guide customers through Cloudflare configuration steps for applicable platform capabilities, including DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Application Security, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, and other Cloudflare products as assigned. Help customers understand configuration options, operational best practices, and standard deployment patterns.</li> <li data-path-to-node="6">Customer Technical Guidance and Enablement: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions, technical walkthroughs, workshops, bootcamps, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical sessions covering Cloudflare product specific best practices, migration procedures, and post-deployment administration. Explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.</li> <li data-path-to-node="7">Documentation and Engagement Hygiene: Produce and maintain clear technical and operational artifacts, including call summaries, action item trackers, onboarding plans, runbooks, and handoff materials. Keep relevant internal systems updated after customer touchpoints and maintain high-quality documentation for continuity across teams.</li> <li data-path-to-node="8">Cross-Functional Coordination and Escalation Management: Coordinate with Cloudflare Customer Engineering, Support, Product, Engineering, Account, and other internal teams to route complex technical issues, document blockers, support escalations, and maintain continuity of customer outcomes.</li> <li data-path-to-node="9">Operational Improvement and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to reusable templates, procedures, technical guides, internal knowledge articles, automation scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and process improvements that improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of customer onboarding and customer engineering activities.</li> <li data-path-to-node="10">Technical Breadth and Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare product foundations, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services, at a depth appropriate to onboarding, adoption, troubleshooting, and technical advisory scenarios. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, internal process updates, and relevant certifications. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support your work.</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="11"><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="12"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,0,0">5-12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Engineer, Technical Support, Implementation Engineer, Onboarding Engineer, Sales/Systems Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or NOC/SOC analyst or equivalent hands-on technical experience managing customer deployments.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,1,0">Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,2,0">Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,3,0">Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,4,0">Configuration and integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,5,0">Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,6,0">Scripting and APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="13"><strong>Working Style:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="14"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Customer empathy: explains technical concepts without jargon; calms frustrated customers.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Structured communication: clear agendas, concise summaries, documented next steps.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,2,0">Bias for action: progresses onboarding rather than waiting; knows when to escalate appropriately.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,3,0">Curiosity: digs into why something works and learns unfamiliar Cloudflare products quickly.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,4,0">Resilience: handles ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and changing priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,5,0">Coachability: accepts feedback and improves from every onboarding engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,6,0">Time management: juggles a portfolio of onboarding customers and meets committed timelines.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="15"><strong>Communication: </strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="15">Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to document clearly, summarize concisely, and interact professionally with both technical and non-technical customer contacts. Regulatory and Security Awareness (Nice-to-Haves): Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.</p> <p data-path-to-node="17"><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The Good-to-Haves):</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="18"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,0,0">Cloudflare Certifications: Existing Cloudflare certifications (e.g., Cloudflare Fundamentals, Cloudflare for Teams, or Cloudflare for Developers).</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,1,0">Prior Cloudflare Experience: Direct experience onboarding or administering Cloudflare in a production environment.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,2,0">Automation Mindset: Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi) or CI/CD pipelines for configuration management.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,3,0">AI-Augmented Workflow: Comfort using AI assistants, LLM-based tools, or scripting to accelerate routine onboarding tasks, log analysis, or documentation.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="18,4,0">Fluency in English is required.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d)
description: Wir suchen einen begeisterten Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin. Als Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) hast du die Möglichkeit, eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Commercial Team einzunehmen. Du nutzt deine zwischenmenschlichen und analytischen Fähigkeiten, um langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen, strategische Ansätze zu identifizieren, umfassende Marktanalysen durchzuführen und Leads zu generieren, um Geschäftsziele voranzutreiben und das Wachstum von FlixTrain zu fördern. Über die Rolle Du unterstützt und setzt Marktstrategien in Zusammenarbeit mit den internationalen Vertriebs- und Marketingteams um, mit Fokus auf Offline-Vertriebskanäle (Fahrkartenautomaten, Drittanbieter-Wiederverkäufer und eigene Shops). Du arbeitest an Umsatzströmen und Kanaleffizienz, identifizierst proaktiv Optimierungsmöglichkeiten und schlägst Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Offline-Kanalperformance für FlixTrain vor. Du trägst aktiv zur Akquise und Entwicklung von Wiederverkaufspartnern bei und sorgst für eine effektive Kommunikation und Unterstützung zur Erfüllung der täglichen Geschäftsanforderungen. Du unterstützt den Abschluss von Handelsverträgen und die Durchführung von Marketingkampagnen zur Stärkung des FlixTrain Offline-Portfolios im DACH-Markt. Du pflegst das CRM-System, um Datengenauigkeit und aktuelle Informationen sicherzustellen. Du verwaltest lokale Verträge, berichtest über Marktkosten und führst Budgetierungsprozesse durch. Du lieferst regelmäßige Performance-Reviews und Updates an interne Stakeholder. Du unterstützt und arbeitest mit deinem eigenen und anderen Teams zusammen, um den gesamtgeschäftlichen Erfolg sicherzustellen. Über Dich Muttersprachliches Niveau in Deutsch (gesprochen und geschrieben) sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Ein Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich. 5–7 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in kaufmännischen Positionen mit Schwerpunkt auf Partnermanagement, Budgetierung und Kostenreporting im Rahmen von Marktaktivitäten. Ausgeprägte soziale, kommunikative und analytische Fähigkeiten. Hohe Leistungsmotivation und unternehmerischer Antrieb. Fähigkeit zur fundierten Berichterstattung und zur tiefgehenden Analyse definierter Herausforderungen. Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, hier etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Lernen & Entwicklung: Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? Our Mission As AI rapidly transforms how information is created and consumed, high-quality proprietary data is becoming the critical ingredient for generating trustworthy insights and enabling better decisions. Models become more powerful as the quality of the underlying data improves. The mission of the Modeled Data department is to develop high-quality proprietary data at scale, empowering our customers to make better business decisions with confidence. To achieve this, we are building the next generation of proprietary data production: a standardized, AI-enabled production system that combines artificial intelligence and human expertise to deliver scalable, transparent, and high-quality outputs. We believe the future is not AI instead of analysts, but AI together with analysts. AI excels at automating repetitive work, scaling production, and accelerating execution, while analysts contribute structured problem solving, statistical reasoning, domain expertise, and critical judgment. Together, they create outcomes that neither could achieve alone. Our analysts therefore have a dual mission: they continuously deepen their expertise in business domains and statistical modeling while simultaneously helping build and improve the AI-powered production platform that will define the future of proprietary data. Your Role As a Working Student, you will support our analysts in building and maintaining proprietary data and contribute to improving our analytical workflows and production systems. Your responsibilities Support the analysis of structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources Assist in collecting, cleaning, and preparing datasets for modeling and analysis Help build and maintain Python-based analytical workflows and scripts Support analysts in identifying trends, patterns, and key market insights Assist in improving data pipelines, methodologies, and documentation Contribute to ongoing projects that aim to make our data production more scalable and efficient Your Profile Enrolled student at a university (mandatory) Field of study in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (preferred) Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills Basic experience with Python (e.g., through coursework, projects, or internships) Interest in data, markets, and business dynamics Ability to work independently and in a structured way Strong written and verbal communication skills (English required, German is a plus) Nice to have Experience with SQL or databases Familiarity with data analysis or visualization tools Exposure to statistical methods or market research Interest in AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) Your Team You will be part of an international, data-driven team working on analytical projects across different markets and industries. You will support real modeling and data production work while gaining hands-on experience with data, tools, and methodologies. This role offers the opportunity to learn how proprietary data is built at scale and how analytical workflows can be combined with AI to create scalable data products. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. title: Junior Full-Stack Developer Next.js
description: Seit der Übernahme durch die CHAPTERS Group AG im Jahr 2025 baut die Linear Service GmbH neben ihrem etablierten Kernsystem für Vereinsverwaltung und Buchhaltung ein komplett neues Cloud-Produkt auf. Das bestehende System bleibt – es läuft weiter und wird von unseren Kunden aus Vereinen, Verbänden und Schulen täglich genutzt. Parallel dazu entsteht auf der grünen Wiese eine moderne Cloud-Produktlinie, von Anfang an mit agentenbasierten AI-Features (Chatbot, Copilot, MCP) gedacht. Dahinter stehen 35 Jahre Erfahrung und ein treuer Kundenstamm – vor uns liegt eine agentenbasierte Zukunft, die wir jetzt gestalten. Für dieses neue Produkt suchen wir einen Junior Developer (m/w/d), der nicht mit jahrelanger Erfahrung kommt, sondern mit der richtigen Haltung: Du entwickelst von Anfang an AI-first – Coding-Agenten sind für dich kein Hilfsmittel, sondern dein Standard-Workflow – und du willst lernen, wie man Agenten nicht nur nutzt, sondern selbst baut und orchestriert. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen und wächst Schritt für Schritt vom Frontend über APIs bis zur Datenbank in die gesamte Plattform hinein. Das Next.js-Ökosystem musst du noch nicht blind beherrschen – du musst es lernen wollen. Aufgaben Feature-Entwicklung: Umsetzung klar abgegrenzter Features in unserer neuen Next.js-Cloud-Plattform (React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL) – mit Mentoring, wachsender Eigenverantwortung und Code-Reviews durch den CTO. AI-First Development: Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding-Agenten (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot o. ä.), beherrschst Planung, Delegation und Review von agentengeneriertem Code und hilfst uns, unsere AI-Entwicklungsworkflows weiter zu verbessern. Agenten-Orchestrierung: Mitarbeit an unseren AI-Features – Tool-Anbindungen über MCP, Agent-Flows mit LangGraph, Prompt-Design, Evals und Guardrails für Chatbot und Copilot. Frontend: Moderne, responsive Benutzeroberflächen mit React/Next.js bauen. Backend-Grundlagen: API-Endpunkte und Datenbankabfragen umsetzen und dabei Schritt für Schritt Full-Stack-Kompetenz aufbauen. Qualität & Dokumentation: Tests schreiben, Features dokumentieren – so, dass auch KI-Agenten damit arbeiten können. Qualifikation Tech-Stack: Solide Basis in JavaScript/TypeScript und erste praktische Erfahrung mit React und Next.js – aus Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, Bootcamp oder eigenen Projekten. SQL und git sitzen. AI-First-Mindset (Muss): Du programmierst bereits mit KI-gestützten Tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot etc.) und kannst zeigen, was du damit gebaut hast. Bereitschaft zur Agenten-Orchestrierung (Muss): Du willst verstehen, wie LLM-Agenten funktionieren – Tool Calling, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, Prompting, Evaluation – und hast idealerweise schon eigene kleine Agenten, Chatbots oder MCP-Server gebaut. Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik o. ä.), Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker/in – oder Quereinstieg mit nachweisbarem Portfolio. Lernkurve: Hohe Eigeninitiative, schnelle Einarbeitung, Freude daran, aus Reviews und Fehlern zu lernen. Sprache & Rechtliches: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland. Nice-to-have: PostgreSQL, Next.js App Router, Erfahrung mit LangGraph/LangChain in einem eigenen Projekt, Open-Source-Beiträge, Grundkenntnisse in der Buchhaltung oder Vereinsarbeit. Benefits Mentoring: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO, regelmäßige Code-Reviews, steile Lernkurve. Freier Gestaltungsspielraum: Volle Freiheit bei der Wahl deines Development-Setups und deiner bevorzugten Coding-Agenten. Echte Grüne Wiese: Keine Altlasten – du baust von Anfang an an einem neuen Cloud-Produkt mit. 100 % Flexibilität: Komplett remote-fähig, flexible Zeiteinteilung; Büro in Berlin Mitte, wenn du magst. Mobilität: Deutschlandticket wird übernommen. Entwicklung: Weiterbildung und Austausch mit mehr als 60 anderen Softwareunternehmen der CHAPTERS Group. Sport & Gesundheit: Geförderte Mitgliedschaft über den Urban Sports Club. Entfalte dein Potenzial als Junior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js) bei Linear Service GmbH! Gestalte Software, die Vereinen hilft, mehr zu erreichen. Werde Teil unserer 35-jährigen Erfolgsgeschichte! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Systems Engineer, MCP Portals
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal </strong></p> <h2>Role Summary</h2> <p>Cloudflare MCP Server Portals give organizations a secure, centralized way to connect AI agents to internal and third-party tools. As a Systems Engineer on the MCP Portals team, you will build and operate the distributed systems that authenticate users, manage OAuth credentials and sessions, enforce Zero Trust policies, and proxy MCP traffic across Cloudflare's global network. You will own scoped projects from design through rollout and production support, working with engineers and product managers across Access, Gateway, and Developer Platform teams. We are looking for an engineer who can make sound technical decisions, work through ambiguous systems problems, and take responsibility for the services they build.</p> <h2>Role Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and operate distributed services that connect MCP clients to authorized upstream MCP servers.</li> <li>Own scoped features and service improvements through design, implementation, testing, rollout, observability, and production follow-up.</li> <li>Evolve our implementation as the MCP specification changes while maintaining compatibility for existing customers and integrations.</li> <li>Build secure authentication and authorization flows involving Cloudflare Access, OAuth, identity, and delegated access to upstream services.</li> <li>Improve the reliability, scalability, latency, and resource efficiency of multi-tenant systems built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform.</li> <li>Use structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to understand service behavior; participate in production support and incident response.</li> <li>Investigate customer issues across multiple services, distinguishing product defects from upstream failures, policy configuration, and infrastructure dependencies.</li> <li>Collaborate with product, security, and engineering partners to turn customer needs and emerging standards into maintainable product capabilities.</li> </ul> <h2>Role Requirements</h2> <h3>Must Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems, backend services, network services, or infrastructure products in production.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C++, or another language used to build production services.</li> <li>Experience independently delivering changes to a production service, including testing, deployment, monitoring, and follow-up.</li> <li>A solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, streaming connections, and common distributed-systems failure modes.</li> <li>Experience debugging production systems using logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, and customer-provided evidence.</li> <li>Ability to reason carefully about security boundaries, credential handling, concurrency, state management, and backward-compatible deployments.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and coordinate work across team boundaries.</li> </ul> <p>Applicants should provide a resume or CV describing relevant engineering and operational experience.</p> <h3>Nice to Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, PKCE, or policy-based access control.</li> <li>Experience with the Model Context Protocol</li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Developer Platform or other serverless edge-computing platforms.</li> <li>Experience building gateways, forward proxies, identity systems, developer platforms, or Zero Trust and data loss prevention products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of €45,000-62,000 </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Partner (m/f/x)
description: Who We Are At Progyny Global , we are on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. As part of Progyny Inc. , we combine world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology to deliver inclusive, culturally competent support for families everywhere. Role Overview We’re looking for a Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Partner to own full-cycle recruitment and help shape the employee experience from offer through the first 180 days. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building strong hiring partnerships, creating thoughtful candidate and new hire experiences, and improving how People processes work as the organization grows. In this role, you’ll go beyond traditional recruiting. You’ll partner closely with hiring managers across teams and regions, guide clear and effective hiring processes, and ensure every candidate and new team member experiences Progyny Global as organized, intentional, and people-centered from the very first interaction. Reporting to the Senior Lead, Global People & Culture , you’ll have the autonomy to make day-to-day decisions, solve problems, and continuously improve the systems, documentation, and workflows that support hiring and employee lifecycle activities. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to deepen their Talent Acquisition expertise while expanding into broader People Operations in a global environment. Tasks Talent Acquisition & Hiring Excellence Own end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions, partnering with hiring managers from intake through offer delivery. Build proactive sourcing strategies and structured, evidence-based hiring processes that support strong decisions and a positive candidate experience. Develop interview guides, assessment frameworks, and practical resources that help hiring managers interview effectively and consistently. Use recruitment data and market insights to improve hiring quality, efficiency, and process consistency. Employee Lifecycle Own the employee journey from accepted offer through successful completion of the 180-day probation period. Coordinate preboarding, onboarding, and cross-functional handoffs that create an organized and welcoming new hire experience. Partner with managers to support integration, probation milestones, and compliant offboarding activities. Operational Excellence Simplify, standardize, and improve recruitment and employee lifecycle workflows as the organization grows. Build and maintain documentation, templates, and knowledge resources that support managers and the People team. Use operational data and technology to reduce manual work and strengthen the employee experience. Use AI, automation, and other tools thoughtfully to improve recruiting workflows, reduce manual work, and create a better experience for candidates and hiring teams. People Operations Develop expertise across core People Operations, including employment documentation, contracts, employee lifecycle administration, and other defined responsibilities. Support day-to-day People Operations with sound judgment, discretion, professionalism, and a strong service mindset. Requirements Required Skills & Experience 4+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Talent Partnering, or a comparable recruitment role, ideally with exposure to People Operations or HR administration. Proven ability to manage full-cycle recruitment independently, partner effectively with hiring managers, and guide processes from intake through offer. Experience improving recruitment, interview, onboarding, or employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced or growing organization. Exposure to onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, contracts, amendments, or employee lifecycle administration, with a strong ability to build expertise where needed. Experience using ATS and HRIS platforms to support accurate, efficient People processes. Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy, discretion, and professionalism. Comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, and knowing when to seek support or escalation. ability to interpret data and present insights to clients. Curious about AI and automation, with an interest in exploring practical ways to improve how Talent Acquisition works. Nice to Have Comfortable supporting international or distributed teams. Track record implementing or optimizing ATS, HRIS, or other People systems. A history of improving operational workflows through automation or technology. Skilled at creating documentation, playbooks, or other operational resources. Benefits Why Join Us Compensation Total compensation includes a competitive base, annual performance bonus, and equity - so you share directly in Progyny's growth. 💰 Competitive Base Salary : From €55,000 – €65,000 per year, depending on experience. 🎯 Bonus Program & Company Equity : Annual Performance Bonus and ownership opportunities to share in Progyny’s success. Benefits & Perks 👶 Fertility & Family-Building Benefits : Access to the Progyny Global Platform with a €5,000 benefits budget. 🧘 Mental Health Support : 1:1 psychologist sessions and wellness tools via Spring Health. 🚲 Sustainable Mobility Benefit : Choice between a Dance e-bike subscription or a BVG public transport ticket. 💪 Urban Sports Club Discount : Access to discounted fitness and wellness activities. 🌴 Paid Leave : 30 days of paid leave per year. 🏡 Hybrid Work : Work from home up to two days per week. ✈️ Remote Work : Up to 8 weeks of remote work per year. 🍽️ Weekly Team Lunches : Team lunch every Thursday. 🐶 Dog Friendly office: Bring your dog to work. We believe that great leaders come from diverse backgrounds. If you’re passionate about building high-performing teams, delivering world-class care, and shaping the future of global member experience, we’d love to hear from you. title: (Senior) Process & Operations Manager - Energy (m/w/d)
description: 1KOMMA5° Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas größten ‘One-Stop-Shop’ für Installationsleistungen im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien auf, damit jeder Haushalt schnell und professionell klimaneutral wohnen, heizen und mobil sein kann. Werde jetzt Teil der Energierevolution und unterstütze uns, Europas Energieversorgung nachhaltig umzugestalten. Denn: Wir stehen vor der größten Herausforderung unserer Zeit – der Energiewende. Um diese zu bewältigen, braucht es richtige Helden – die Helden der Energiewende. Bei 1KOMMA5° ziehen wir alle an einem Strang und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um unser Ziel zu erreichen. Hast du Lust, die Energierevolution mit uns anzugehen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt – wir suchen Verstärkung für unser Energy Team bevorzugt an unserem Standort in Berlin. Werde Teil unserer Mission! Erfahre über unser Product & Tech Team! Deine Position Als Energy Team sind wir Teil des Tech Teams von 1KOMMA5° Heartbeat GmbH. Wir arbeiten täglich daran, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten und innovative Projekte und digitale Produkte voranzutreiben. Wir suchen ab sofort einen motivierten (Senior) Process & Operations Manager - Energy (m/w/d), der den Smart Meter Rollout an unseren deutschen Standorten organisiert und die Prozesse rund um unseren dynamischen Stromtarif erfolgreich umsetzt. Wir arbeiten täglich daran, dass unsere digitalen Produkte tausenden Kund:innen weltweit zur Verfügung stehen. Wir wachsen stark und suchen deshalb Verstärkung! Was zählt ist, dass du motiviert bist, untenstehende Aufgaben anzugehen, Gas zu geben und eine steile Lernkurve suchst! title: Customer Engineer, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Seoul, South Korea, Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></p> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> <strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1891 </p> <p>ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.</p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS: hardware/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.</p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product</li> <li>Act as the programme’s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.</p> <p>You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build/buy/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)</li> <li>Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:<br></strong></p> <p>You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.</p> <p><strong> What We Offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world</li> <li>A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence</li> <li>Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career</li> <li>Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track</li> <li>A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies</li> <li>A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts</li> <li>A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) | Deutschsprachig
description: Über Yepoda Clean K-Beauty Innovation. Ohne Kompromisse. Yepoda ist eine Clean K-Beauty Brand, die hält, was sie verspricht. Wir entwickeln koreanische Hautpflege ohne Kompromisse: klinisch getestet, 100 % vegan und nach Standards formuliert, die über die EU-Anforderungen hinausgehen. So vereinen wir die Innovation und Wirksamkeit, für die K-Beauty bekannt ist, mit einem echten Engagement für Nachhaltigkeit. Und das Beste: Unsere Produkte machen Hautpflege einfach, effektiv und zu einem Ritual, auf das man sich jeden Tag freut. Gegründet wurde Yepoda 2020 von Sander Joonyoung van Bladel und Veronika Strotmann. Als zertifizierte B Corp™ und Mitglied von 1% for the Planet haben wir unseren Hauptsitz im Herzen Berlins. Unsere Produkte sind über unseren eigenen Onlineshop erhältlich und seit März 2025 außerdem bei Sephora Europe – online sowie in über 650 Stores. Mit einem internationalen Team von mehr als 140 talentierten Menschen gestalten wir die Geschichte von Yepoda jeden Tag aktiv weiter. Für unser Team in Berlin suchen wir aktuell einen Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) . In dieser Rolle verantwortest du ein Portfolio strategischer Creator-Partnerschaften für den deutschen Markt und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Umsatzwachstum, Markenbekanntheit und nachhaltigen Business Impact durch leistungsstarke Influencer-Kooperationen voranzutreiben. Die Position ist ideal für Menschen mit ausgeprägtem „Business-Mindset“, die Freude an Verhandlungen haben, Wachstumspotenziale erkennen, strategische Beziehungen aufbauen und ambitionierte Ziele übertreffen möchten. Wir suchen jemanden, der Influencer Marketing nicht nur als Kampagnenkanal versteht, sondern als skalierbaren Wachstumstreiber für das Unternehmen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest und entwickelst ein Portfolio strategischer Creator-Partnerschaften mit klar definierten Umsatz-, Performance- und Wachstumszielen. Du identifizierst, akquirierst und gewinnst Creator-Kooperationen mit hohem Potenzial und messbarem Business Impact. Du führst Vertrags- und Konditionsverhandlungen eigenständig und findest die richtige Balance zwischen nachhaltigem Beziehungsaufbau, Unternehmenszielen und Profitabilität. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Creator:innen, Agenturen und Partnern auf und pflegst diese mit einem klaren wachstumsorientierten Fokus. Du steuerst Influencer-Kampagnen mit besonderem Fokus auf Performance, ROI, Reichweite, Engagement und Umsatzbeitrag. Du analysierst die Performance von Kampagnen und Creator:innen und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungs- und Skalierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du erkennst neue Wachstumschancen, Creator-Trends und innovative Kooperationsmodelle im deutschen Markt frühzeitig. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Paid Media, Brand, Creative und E-Commerce zusammen, um die Performance entlang des gesamten Funnels zu maximieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ambitionierte KPIs und entwickelst kontinuierlich neue Ansätze, um Ergebnisse weiter zu verbessern und Ziele zu übertreffen. Dein Profil Du bringst 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Sales, Account Management, Partnership Management, Affiliate Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Media Sales oder vergleichbaren kommerziell geprägten Rollen mit. Du verfügst über ein starkes „Business-Mindset“ und hast bereits Verantwortung für Umsatz-, Wachstums- oder Performance-Ziele übernommen. Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke und hervorragende Fähigkeiten im Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen. Du fühlst dich in dynamischen, zielorientierten Umfeldern wohl und arbeitest eigenverantwortlich sowie ergebnisorientiert. Du kennst die deutsche Digital-, Creator- und Beauty-Landschaft sehr gut. Du arbeitest datenbasiert, analysierst KPIs sicher und kannst Erkenntnisse in konkrete Maßnahmen übersetzen. Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an. Du schaffst den Spagat zwischen strategischem Denken und operativer Umsetzung. Erfahrung in den Bereichen DTC, Beauty, FMCG, Lifestyle, Creator Economy oder in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen ist ein großes Plus. Was wir dir bieten Dynamisches Umfeld : Arbeite in einem engagierten und leidenschaftlichen Start-up-Team Karriere-Booster : Übernimm Verantwortung ab Tag 1 – mit vielen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen Inspirierender Arbeitsplatz : Im Herzen von Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg, hundefreundliches Büro, kostenlose Getränke und wöchentliche Yoga-Klassen Hybrides Arbeiten : Wir wissen, dass man manchmal zu Hause produktiver ist – oder einfach einen Tapetenwechsel braucht Vielfalt ist für uns selbstverständlich : Ein diverses, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und Vertrauen als Basis Mitarbeiterrabatt : Profitiere von Vergünstigungen auf Yepoda-Produkte und teile sie mit deinen Liebsten Add Ons : Ein monatliches Benefits-Budget, das du frei nutzen kannst. In der Probonio-App suchst du dir aus, was wirklich zu deinem Lifestyle passt Möchtest du Teil unseres Teams werden? Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes. Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring. Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards). Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes. Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions. Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met. Requirements What You’ll Need 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry Experience with supplier quality management. Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken. Audit training/certification or experience setting up ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required. Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs). Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills Who You Are You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards.
