title: Software Engineer, Platform - Zurich, Switzerland
description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  </p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. </p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Switzerland Based </strong>Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.</p><p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job? </strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? </strong></p> <p>Refer them! </p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. </strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Product Engineer
description: The Context Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do. Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows. We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath. The Mission You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production. This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin. Your responsibilities Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production. Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop. Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome. Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work. Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”. Your profile Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus. Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build. Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters. Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases. AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Location</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>London, United Kingdom</strong></li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>As an Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work as a hands-on, consultative build partner to a portfolio of Cloudflare's most strategic customers — companies building complex, ambitious applications on our developer platform. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with their engineering teams to shape architecture, prototype alongside them, review code, and unblock the hard technical problems that stand between them and production — so they can build faster and scale further on Cloudflare.</p> <p>This is a one-to-many motion. Rather than embedding full-time with a single account, you'll work in parallel, bringing patterns, reference implementations, lessons learned from across your portfolio to every customer you work with. Customers come to us building on the developer platform, but when we engage we support the full breadth of the Cloudflare platform.</p> <p>You operate as a technical force multiplier — helping customers ship, raising the quality of what they build, and surfacing real-world product insights back to Cloudflare's Product and Engineering teams.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Act as the hands-on technical build partner across a portfolio of strategic customers building on the Cloudflare platform, driving each engagement forward from idea to launch.</li> <li>Shape scalable, resilient architectures on Cloudflare and guide customers on the design decisions that matter — before they become bottlenecks.</li> <li>Hands-on development alongside customer teams to prototype, configure, and build reference implementations that demonstrate the right way to solve a problem on Cloudflare.</li> <li>Review customer code and share the best practices that raise the quality, performance, and security of what they build.</li> <li>Diagnose and resolve hard technical problems across the stack, removing the blockers between customers and a successful launch.</li> <li>Write reference code, samples, and technical guidance that customers can learn from, build on, and reuse.</li> <li>Support the full breadth of the Cloudflare platform when engaged — from Workers, storage (KV, R2, D1), and Durable Objects to AI (Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize), security, networking, and observability.</li> <li>Join Customer Engineering rituals — design reviews, planning sessions, and technical working sessions.</li> <li>Surface real-world edge cases, friction, and product gaps directly to Cloudflare's Product and Engineering teams to shape the product roadmap.</li> <li>Establish and maintain trusted technical relationships with customer engineers and technical leaders (Staff+ engineers, Directors, and VPs).</li> <li>Identify opportunities to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare services, unlocking new capabilities across each customer's tech stack.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Engineering Pedigree & Customer-Facing Experience</strong>: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including time in a customer-facing engineering role — such as forward deployed, solutions or sales engineering, professional services, or developer relations — where you worked hands-on with external engineering teams. You are a builder at heart, with a track record of delivering production-grade systems, not just advising on them.</li> <li><strong>Languages</strong>: You are experienced with modern languages like TypeScript, Rust, and Go.</li> <li><strong>Active Practitioner</strong>: You have a "ship-first" mentality and maintain a high velocity, staying current with modern frameworks, languages, and deployment patterns.</li> <li><strong>Full-Stack Architectural Depth</strong>: Broad technical fluency across the entire stack — from frontend performance and backend logic to data/storage and distributed infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Production Maturity</strong>: You've owned mission-critical services with real-world users. You understand production rigor, the urgency of incident response, and the architectural discipline required to run highly available systems.</li> <li><strong>AI-Native Development</strong>: You have integrated AI-augmented workflows (e.g., Windsurf, OpenCode) into your daily development cycle to accelerate prototyping and delivery.</li> <li><strong>Systems Design & Strategic Thinking</strong>: Ability to decompose complex business requirements into scalable, resilient technical architectures. You can visualize the "big picture" without losing sight of the implementation details.</li> <li><strong>Cloud Ecosystem Fluency</strong>: Deep experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including an understanding of serverless, networking, and security primitives.</li> <li><strong>High Agency & Navigating Ambiguity</strong>: You are a self-starter who thrives in "zero-to-one" environments. You don't wait for a ticket; you identify the problem and own the solution end-to-end.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence</strong>: Comfortable engaging in high-stakes technical and strategic discussions with VP-level stakeholders, with the ability to translate complex engineering trade-offs into business impact.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience building on Cloudflare Workers or the broader Cloudflare Developer Platform.</li> <li>A visible public profile, including open-source contributions, technical blogging, or speaking engagements at industry conferences.</li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability,

title: AI Engineer
description: Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. What you will do: AI & Automation Engineering Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. AI Governance and Inventory Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. Data Engineering and Platform Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables. Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. Requirements 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). Equally important is how you think: You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. Nice to have: Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. What we are not looking for: "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. Benefits Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure Our culture At the heart of our company, we prioritize: Innovation and Continuous Learning Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity Please note: We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies. Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered. If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references. Du hast Spaß daran, dich mit neuen Technologien, Start-ups und Entwicklungen zu beschäftigen und herauszufinden, was davon für die Versicherungswirtschaft relevant werden könnte? Du recherchierst und analysierst gern, denkst kreativ und hast Lust, deine eigenen Ideen und Perspektiven einzubringen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen, um zu schauen, wie du unser Team als Werkstudent:in Innovation, New Business & Startups (all people) mit 15 – 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kannst! Wir, die Versicherungsforen Leipzig, unterstützen Unternehmen der Versicherungswirtschaft bei ihren Forschungs- und Entwicklungsvorhaben. Wir erforschen und analysieren neue Trends, erarbeiten daraus konkrete Anforderungen für die Unternehmen und entwickeln gemeinsam Lösungsansätze. Neben Marktanalysen, Studien sowie Strategieberatung sind die Versicherungsforen Leipzig als Anbieter von Aus- und Weiterbildungsformaten wie Seminaren, Fachkonferenzen und Messekongressen bekannt. Das bewirkst du bei uns: Du wirkst im Tagesgeschäft und in Projekten rund um Innovation & New Business in der Versicherungswirtschaft mit. Du recherchierst und analysierst aktuelle Trends, Technologien, Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Marktentwicklungen und bereitest relevante Impulse für unsere Projekte und Formate auf. Du bringst dich kreativ in die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Ideen und Formate ein – von der ersten Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung. Du arbeitest an unserem Trendradar mit, recherchierst und bewertest neue Entwicklungen, bereitest Inhalte auf, führst Plausibilitätschecks durch und erstellst begleitende Unterlagen. Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops, Veranstaltungen und weiteren Austauschformaten und wirkst bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen und Arbeitsmaterialien mit. Du bereitest Erkenntnisse, Trends und Impulse zielgruppengerecht auf und hilfst uns dabei, auch komplexe Themen verständlich und ansprechend für unterschiedliche Kommunikations- und Austauschformate zu vermitteln. Du wirkst aktiv in unserem New Players Network mit und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Start-up- und InsurTech-Szene. Dabei recherchierst du neue Unternehmen und ihre Geschäftsmodelle, identifizierst interessante New Player, unterstützt die Vernetzung in unserem Start-up-Netzwerk und wirkst bei unseren Pitch- und Austauschformaten mit. Darum passt du zu uns: Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor dir und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Du interessierst dich für Innovation, neue Technologien, Trends und Geschäftsmodelle und hast Lust, dich mit neuen Themen auseinanderzusetzen. Du recherchierst gern, kannst Informationen strukturiert und verständlich aufbereiten und gehst sicher mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen um. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und sorgfältig, bist neugierig, kreativ und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein. Du interessierst dich für generative KI und hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools gesammelt. Was uns verbindet: Demokratie, Vielfalt und Toleranz sind für uns nicht nur gesellschaftliche Grundwerte, sondern die Basis unseres Miteinanders : Wir stehen für Weltoffenheit, gegenseitigen Respekt und Chancengleichheit und heißen Menschen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität bei uns willkommen. Freue dich auf Folgendes: Bei uns kannst du deine Kenntnisse in innovativen Themen vertiefen, eigene Ideen einbringen und deine Fähigkeiten aktiv weiterentwickeln. Du bekommst Einblicke in verschiedene Themenbereiche und sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung. Dich erwarten eine lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre, flache Hierarchien und viel Raum für eigenständiges Arbeiten. Für deine Energie und Konzentration sorgen wir mit einer Kaffee-, Tee- und Wasserflat. Deine Arbeitszeiten und -orte kannst du flexibel an dein Studium anpassen. Unser modernes Büro liegt zentral in Leipzig und in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Universität. Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents, Gesundheitsangebote und weitere gemeinsame Aktionen sorgen für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag. Wie gehts jetzt weiter? Du fühlst dich angesprochen und möchtest gern mit uns durchstarten? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kleines Motivationsschreiben. Bei Fragen kannst du dich gerne direkt an unsere Recruiterin Jule wenden – telefonisch unter 0341 98988 123 oder per Mail an . Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: Electrical Engineer (Gimbal)

Responsibilities High-performance embedded system design : Define the architecture and design the physical and electrical integration of complex systems based on processors, fast memory (DDR, Flash), and peripherals (e.g. embedded computers/calculators, sensors, video processing…). Electromagnetic compatibility : Address and resolve EMC challenges while ensuring signal integrity. Testing and Validation : Conduct testing, integration, and performance validation of electronic boards to meet operational and design requirements. Communication & Influence : Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of interacting with diverse principals—from junior members to senior executives. Commitment : 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. title: Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. About the role As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly. Responsibilities Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms. High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity. Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour. Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication. Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs. Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification. Candidate requirements Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production. Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour. Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium). Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs. Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production. Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description: <p><strong>REQ ID:</strong> FEQ227R147</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based)</p> <p><strong>Recruiter:</strong> Dina Hussain</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our <strong>EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups </strong>business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.</li> <li>Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.</li> <li>Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.</li> <li>Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.</li> <li>Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Recruitment Fraud Alert</strong></p> <p>We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  </p> <p><strong>What to know:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commvault does <em>not</em> conduct interviews by email or text.</li> <li>We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.</li> <li>Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.</li> </ul> <p>If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at <u><a ---------- <p> </p> <p><strong>About Commvault</strong> </p> <p>Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. </p></div><p>Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects.  The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate/expand his/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers’ environment, current challenges/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition.  The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established - large, complex prospects and customer.</li> <li>Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.</li> <li>Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer/prospect leadership.</li> <li>Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.</li> <li>Manage a matrixed sales team; title: HR & EOR Operations Manager
description: Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity ABOUT THE CLIENT Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world. The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position. As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form. Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities. This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio. WHAT YOU'LL DO Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law. Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment). Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections. Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities. Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters. Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team. Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters. Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required: Swiss citizen. EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit. Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify). EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit. Education: Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field. Experience - either route qualifies: Standard route: 3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV. Alternative route: 3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count. Character: Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history. Other: Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority. Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities. Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position. You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team. The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage. The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them. WORKING ENVIRONMENT Fully remote within Switzerland. Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours. Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER Health insurance contributions. Share incentives. Learning and mentorship opportunities. Team offsites and social events. 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Manager - Berlin
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Job Description Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Payments Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Payments Team to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution. If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of success selling direct payment solutions to enterprise companies, in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivaled uncapped recurring commissions plan, hybrid work model and competitive benefits package. The Senior Sales Manager will play a key role in growing Checkout.com ’s payments footprint. They will be responsible for selling Checkout.com ’s full payments technology stack to middle market and large enterprise organizations. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. Desire an independent, high-achieving individual that stands out in an entrepreneurial environment and has the grit and desire to outperform sales targets. How you’ll make impact: ● Acting as a consultative Payments strategist able to advise companies on an optimal payments structure that pulls from a myriad of solutions Checkout.com provides ● Identify, qualify and close the most promising prospects and partners that will help Checkout.com grow a healthy pipeline across various verticals. ● Build prospect engagement strategies and partner with marketing, business development, product and other departments to build qualified that pipeline in cold and warm channels ● Pitch our next-generation payment solutions and value-added services ● Prepare high-quality presentations and proposals for C-suite stakeholders at prospective merchants, and implement winning negotiation strategies ● Become the expert on Checkout.com ’s technology stack, help new merchants understand the value of Checkout.com to solve their pain points, and handle detailed questions about our product capabilities. ● Orchestrate the entire Sales process, drive urgency and work to mutual action plans, and act as the main point of contact for merchants and internal stakeholders. ● Maintain a solid, well-organized portfolio and nurture key accounts by having a deep understanding of their industry, pain points, and needs. ● Partner with other Payment Sales Managers to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends. ● Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information. Qualifications: ● 3+ years Enterprise Sales experience directly in the Payments industry ● Track record of high performance, and self sourcing leads ● Highly motivated and committed to growth and development with excellent communication skills ● Solid network of potential prospects and partners within the payments landscape ● Tech-savvy, with a passion for Fintech and Payments ● Strong commercial acumen, ability to effectively negotiate complex structures ● Fluent in English + German Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

security, cloud security, infrastructure security or a comparable technical role Good understanding of Zero Trust principles and modern cybersecurity technologies Hands-on experience in one or more areas such as IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network security, segmentation, cloud security, endpoint security or access control Good understanding of enterprise networks, identity, authentication and cloud Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Sentinel, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Experience with title: Security Engineer
description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. About the role As a Security Engineer at Namespace, you'll own and strengthen security across our systems, network, and infrastructure. You'll work closely with engineering and operations to identify vulnerabilities, build security measures and best practices, and ensure security is embedded into how we build and operate. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in. What you'll do Design and build novel firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), and intrusion prevention systems (IPS) to fortify our servers, networks, and systems Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments, evaluating technologies and core systems for weaknesses and potential vulnerabilities Develop security measures to quickly detect and respond to real-time threats and vulnerabilities Develop security-first guidelines and best practices for the entire organization to follow Work closely with operations, developers, and other stakeholders to build and maintain a one-team approach to security Support the sales team with security questionnaires and technical security requirements from customers What we're looking for Strong security engineering fundamentals, with hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, systems, and networks Experience with network security, firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention, vulnerability management, and threat detection and response Ability to identify security risks and translate them into pragmatic technical solutions Strong understanding of security best practices across modern cloud and infrastructure environments Ability to work closely with engineering and operations teams and embed security into existing systems and workflows Bias toward execution and ownership, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment You can expect: Competitive salary and stock options Flexible working hours Market-leading parental leave Life at Namespace Labs: We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot. We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism. We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions. title: Revenue Operations Manager - Switzerland
description: About the Role Neural Concept's Revenue Operations function sits at the heart of how we scale commercially. Bridging Sales, Finance, and GTM Strategy, you will drive the operational engine behind our revenue growth — ensuring that every deal we pursue, every resource we allocate, and every commercial decision we make is grounded in data, financial discipline, and operational precision. As RevOps Manager, you will partner directly with our Finance Director to build and run the commercial infrastructure that powers our growth. You will own revenue forecasting, GTM analytics, sales process design, and the systems that make our commercial teams faster and smarter. This is not a back-office role — it is a strategic seat at the table, working side by side with Sales, Finance, and Leadership to turn data into decisions and friction into performance. Neural Concept is on a mission to transform how the world's leading engineering organisations design products, with AI at the centre of product development. This is a chance to build the revenue engine of a company that is reshaping an entire industry and work within AI with concrete and tangible real-life outcomes. Build and manage dashboards tracking ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, win rates, and commercial KPIs across segments and geographies. Develop financial scenarios to support pricing decisions, headcount planning, and growth investments. Proactively identify, evaluate, and deploy AI-powered tools to streamline lead routing, pipeline management, contract workflows, and reporting. Partner with Sales and Marketing and IT and Systems teams to automate processes and eliminate manual work across the commercial funnel. Support quota setting, territory planning, and commission model design in close partnership with the Finance Director and Sales leadership. Build financial models to evaluate the ROI of commercial initiatives, GTM experiments, and market expansion scenarios. Deep CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot) — demonstrated ability to administer, optimise, and scale CRM systems to support a growing GTM team without relying on external technical support. Strong commercial acumen — you understand the mechanics of enterprise sales cycles, deal structures, pipeline health, pricing models, and revenue retention, and you translate that understanding into sharp operational decisions. Genuinely technology-savvy — you actively seek out and deploy AI tools to automate, improve, and accelerate your work. You are comfortable evaluating new platforms, running pilots, and embedding technology into operational workflows. You see AI as a fundamental lever for RevOps, not a nice-to-have. title: Fundraising & Investor Relations – Associate / Vice President
description: Zug, Switzerland | Full-time Reports to: Head of Fundraising & Investor Relations About Blue Earth Capital Blue Earth Capital is a global, independent specialist impact investment firm headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with team members based in London, New York, Madrid and Konstanz. With approximately USD 1.9 billion in assets under management, we invest across Private Equity, Private Credit and Private Equity Partnerships, seeking measurable environmental and social impact alongside attractive, market-rate financial returns. BlueEarth is owned by the Blue Earth Foundation, a Swiss charitable foundation that uses the firm’s profits to support philanthropic initiatives. The role Help grow our investor base across DACH, Nordic and Benelux markets. You will develop investor relationships and progress fundraising opportunities across our investment strategies and bespoke solutions, working closely with the Head of Fundraising DACH. What you will do Develop an agreed portfolio of existing and prospective investors, building trusted relationships and tailored engagement plans. Identify and approach new prospects, turning investor dialogue into a well-prioritised fundraising pipeline. Align DACH investor targeting, relationship ownership and fundraising execution with the Head of Fundraising DACH. Progress assigned opportunities from initial engagement through due diligence and investor decisions, coordinating colleagues and follow-up. Coordinate investor reporting, updates and queries with internal teams, providing responsive and accurate service. What we offer An entrepreneurial environment with responsibility from an early stage, close collaboration with experienced colleagues and the opportunity to develop across a global impact investment platform. We offer competitive compensation reflecting your experience and contribution. What you bring Relevant experience in private-markets fundraising, investor relations or distribution, with evidence of contributing to fundraising outcomes. Strong private-markets knowledge and the ability to build understanding across the BlueEarth platform. Commercial judgement and clear communication of investment strategies, financial objectives and impact to investors. Strong relationship and project-management skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage concurrent priorities. Professional fluency in German and English, with willingness to travel regularly to our target markets. A clear motivation for impact investing. Direct impact-investing experience is an advantage. title: Scientific Data Architect - Basel, Switzerland
description: About TetraScience TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft. In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “ The Tetra Way ,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you. Who You Are You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions. You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions. You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done . You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users. You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data. With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions. You are an insatiable learner , with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains. You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML. This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry. What You Have Done PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing. Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders. Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible. Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities. Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes. Requirements What You Will Do You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI . As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Basel region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions. Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability. Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform. Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including: Data model design (tabular & JSON) Python-based parser development. Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs. Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid) Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files. Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders. Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform. Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases Benefits Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company. Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement. Generous paid time off (PTO). Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.</p> <p>The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. </p> <p>One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. </p> <p>That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.</p> <p>Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.</p> <p>Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. </p></div><h2>Role & Team</h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Data Engineer</strong> at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.</p> <p>You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.</p> <p><strong>Time zone requirement: </strong>Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p>In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.</li> <li>Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.</li> <li>Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.</li> <li>Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.</li> <li>Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.</li> <li>Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure</li> <li>10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with <strong>Dagster</strong> — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)</li> <li>Proven track record building and operating <strong>data pipelines</strong> at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning</li> <li>Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices</li> <li>Strong <strong>system design</strong> skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them</li> <li>Practical experience designing <strong>service-oriented architecture</strong>, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations</li> <li>Strong <strong>Python</strong> skills and experience with <strong>Google Cloud</strong></li> <li>Experience with <strong>Pub/Sub</strong> and event-driven patterns</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product</li> <li>Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers</li> <li>Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice To Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored</li> <li>Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference</li> <li>Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery</li> <li>Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production</li> <li>Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Note:</strong> We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.</em></p> <h2><strong>What We Offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits </li> <li>Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around</li> <li>Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets </li> <li>A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values</li> <li>To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Our Team</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.</p> <p>We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.</p> <h2><strong>Our Values</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.</strong></h4> <p>We act with urgency.</p> <h4><strong>Our curiosity fuels our growth.</strong></h4> <p>We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.</p> <h4><strong>We’re rooted in diversity.</strong></h4> <p>Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.</p> <h4><strong>We care for each other.</strong></h4> <p>We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.</p> <h4><strong>Trust is fundamental.</strong></h4> <p>We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.</p> <p>_________________________________</p> <p data-start="90" data-end="127"><strong data-start="90" data-end="125">Use of AI in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p><em>We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide. </p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who We Are </span></h4> <p>BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we’ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries — with experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company’s international growth. </p> <p>At BridgeBio, you’ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. In this role you ensure alignment of HEOR priorities with clinical value, launch timelines, and market access strategy.</p> <p>You will also be a core member of the International Market Access team, contributing HEOR and evidence-generation expertise to global decision-making and ensuring alignment across regions while representing diverse market perspectives.</p> <p>This role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders across multiple countries to ensure high-quality execution and impact.
